# Fontes coverage catalogue

What Fontes reaches in each jurisdiction: its courts and types of legislation, each marked reached or not; the sources and their terms; and what Fontes does not reach, and why. Counts read reached + partly½ / all rows, so `5+1½/8` means 5 rows reached and 1 partly reached, out of 8. Generated by `scripts/catalogue.py`; do not edit by hand.

**How reliable the court lists are.** Whether each row is reached comes from reading the adapter code. The court and legislation lists themselves were drafted by AI agents from their own knowledge, checked against an official page where one could be opened. Many official judiciary sites were blocked or unreachable, so a listed reference does not always mean the page was read. Countries marked UNVERIFIED had no official source at all. Treat the lists as a draft to check, not an authority.

**The last column** says, for anything Fontes does not fully reach, whether it can be reached at all: 🟢 available (an official or licensed source publishes it; Fontes has not built it), 🔒 blocked (a source exists but robots.txt, terms, a bot wall, a login or a paywall stops us), ⚫ offline (checked: not published online), ❓ unknown. Each entry says what it rests on: 'fetched <date>' means the page was opened that day; 'search result only' is weaker. Sites that time out from the UK are marked unknown or blocked with a note; geo-blocking is not proven.

124 adapters; 85 UN member states without one.

## Coverage scorecard

A jurisdiction counts as covered when Fontes reaches at least one of two areas completely: the precedents of its top general court (the Yargıtay equivalent), or its constitution and primary acts (kanun level and above). Secondary legislation and lower courts do not count. ✅ complete (minor gaps noted), ◐ gap (something published is missing, or the source is off until permission), ❌ none. Judgement calls are in research/scorecard_overrides.json.

- Arabic (authoritative) JO issues: /FTP/jo-arabe/{year}/A{year}{jo:03}.pdf, HTTP 200; 1975, 1990, 2000 and 2001 have no text layer; where a text layer exists its font map is broken differently per era (2003: custom-encoded glyph garbage; 2008: letters in order but words reversed and ligatures mapped to 'J', '~', 's'; 2024: each line character-reversed, digits scrambled), so the Arabic text is not served (checked 2026-11-10)
- Laws are as published, not consolidated (no official consolidation on joradp.dz; mjustice.dz, droit.mjustice.dz and apn.dz timed out from the UK, 2026-11-10)
- Arabic (authoritative) edition of laws and Constitutional Court decisions: source has it, not built (French only)

**Sources and terms**

- Tribunal Constitucional del Principat d'Andorra: sentències and autes — https://www.tribunalconstitucional.ad/ (caselaw) — unknown: the legal notice names the court as owner, says 'Tots els drets reservats' and is silent on reuse or automated access (checked 2026-11-06)
- Portal Jurídic del Principat d'Andorra (BOPA service, Govern d'Andorra / Consell General): consolidated laws and Government regulations — https://portaljuridicandorra.ad/ (legislation) — Govern d'Andorra legal notice: all rights reserved; only personal use of downloadable files is authorised, commercial use not permitted; no commercial use
  - ⚠ Personal use only: Portal Jurídic terms allow personal use only, no commercial use; consolidated texts are unofficial (the BOPA is the only authentic version).
- Consell General del Principat d'Andorra: Constitució (Catalan booklet PDF) — https://www.consellgeneral.ad/fitxers/documents/constitucio (legislation) — unknown: consellgeneral.ad has no legal notice or terms page (checked 2026-11-10); the Constitution is an official text
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Catalan. Case law: Tribunal Constitucional judgments (sentències) and orders (autes) since 1993; ordinary courts (justicia.ad) not covered. Legislation: the Constitution (Consell General, id CONSTITUCIO) and Portal Jurídic consolidated laws and regulations (personal use only).

**Does not reach**

- Official gazette (BOPA, bopa.ad): search runs through Azure Functions keyed from its public JS; no official key or open endpoint
- Ordinary courts (Tribunal Superior de Justícia, Tribunal de Corts, Batllia): justicia.ad embeds the CGPJ (CENDOJ) search at jurisprudencia.poderjudicial.es/andorra, which answers 403 without browser XHR headers, has a CAPTCHA flow, and whose notice allows personal consultation only, no bulk download, reuse for databases only via a CGPJ procedure
- Decrets legislatius: no separate type in Portal Jurídic; their consolidated texts are reached only where filed as the law's text refós

**Sources and terms**

- InfoLEG – search (servicios.infoleg.gob.ar, Ministerio de Justicia) — https://servicios.infoleg.gob.ar/infolegInternet/ (legislation) — Creative Commons Reconocimiento 2.5 Argentina (infoleg.gob.ar footer)
  - ⚠ Search results come from InfoLEG, whose Aviso legal asks for written permission to link to infoleg.gob.ar or put its data in databases; Fontes queries it live, stores nothing and links to argentina.gob.ar.
- InfoLEG – Leyes Argentinas (Ministerio de Justicia, argentina.gob.ar/normativa) — https://www.argentina.gob.ar/normativa (legislation) — Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (argentina.gob.ar Términos y condiciones); commercial use allowed
  - ⚠ CC BY 4.0: credit 'InfoLEG – Ministerio de Justicia de la Nación' when reusing. Consolidated texts are not official; only the Boletín Oficial is authentic.
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: National legislation (consolidated where InfoLEG has it, per article) from argentina.gob.ar. Search is InfoLEG's full-text search over every national norm (laws by default; newest first; national codes and the constitution listed first on page 1). No case law: SAIJ's terms forbid non-interface access and CSJN's search is behind reCAPTCHA.

**Does not reach**

- Case law, all courts via SAIJ: terms forbid obtaining content 'por cualquier otro medio' than the interface
- Supreme Court (CSJN) judgments: sj.csjn.gov.ar is behind reCAPTCHA; datos.csjn.gov.ar has no judgments
- Buenos Aires Supreme Court (JUBA): official, reachable, provincial only; source exists but not built yet
- Consolidated text: InfoLEG has it only for norms it keeps updated; others come as the original text (a norm with no text online raises NotFound)
- Provincial legislation: SAIJ terms forbid automated use; provincial official sites not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Federal Register of Legislation, Office of Parliamentary Counsel — https://www.legislation.gov.au (legislation) — CC BY 4.0 (attribute to the Federal Register of Legislation and link legislation.gov.au; Coat of Arms and third-party material excluded); commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Commonwealth legislation only (latest compilation). No case law: the High Court and Federal Court sites block non-browser clients, and AustLII is not official. Search matches title words only and cannot filter by date (no year_from/year_to). Ids are FRL title ids, e.g. C2004A00109 (Competition and Consumer Act 2010); schedule sections are 'Sch 2 s 18'.

**Does not reach**

- High Court judgments: hcourt.gov.au (Akamai) resets every request from this client (2026-11-05)
- Federal Court judgments: Cloudflare managed challenge (403) even for robots.txt
- State and territory legislation: Qld API needs a free key we have not signed up for; NSW Cloudflare; others not built
- State court judgments: NSW Caselaw robots.txt disallows /decision and /search; other states not researched yet
- Full-text search of Commonwealth legislation: FRL API answers 400 to body search; title search only

**Sources and terms**

- RIS — Rechtsinformationssystem des Bundes (OGD API v2.6) — https://data.bka.gv.at/ris/api/v2.6/ (caselaw, legislation) — CC BY 4.0 (stated in the RIS OGD FAQ at data.bka.gv.at/ris/api/v2.6/); commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision
- Notes: Federal consolidated law (current version) and decisions of OGH/ordinary courts, VfGH, VwGH, BVwG, LVwG and DSB. Law id = Gesetzesnummer (ABGB 10001622). Party names are anonymised. Decision ids: RIS document number or ECLI.

**Does not reach**

- State law (Landesrecht): in the RIS OGD API (LrKons); source exists but not built yet
- Whole-law text in one call: only on www.ris.bka.gv.at, which sits behind a bot check (per-paragraph text only)
- Historical versions of federal law: in the API (Fassung.FassungVom); not built yet, current version only
- Municipal and district law (Gemeinden, Bezirke endpoints): source exists but not built yet
- Bundesfinanzgericht (BFG) decisions: not in the court filter

**Sources and terms**

- Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission (هيئة التشريع والرأي القانوني), lloc.gov.bh — https://www.lloc.gov.bh (legislation, caselaw) — Site terms: content is copyright LLOC; modifying it or using it 'for any other purposes' is called an infringement. Separately, Bahraini copyright law (22/2006 art. 4(b)) excludes legislation and judgments from copyright, but that does not lift the site's terms on automated use: reuse still needs LLOC's permission.; off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ LLOC's terms reserve copyright and forbid modifying content or using it 'for other purposes'; texts are passed on unmodified for reference. Check the official PDF before relying on them. Even with permission this source holds legislation and Constitutional Court judgments only, not Court of Cassation judgments.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Arabic. LLOC database of all Bahraini legislation (consolidated .docx where LLOC has one, else the text as published) and Constitutional Court judgments. No official open source for Court of Cassation judgments.

**Does not reach**

- Everything (lloc.gov.bh): terms forbid using content 'for any other purposes'; needs permission, off by default
- Court of Cassation and lower-court judgments: no official open source found
- English translations, treaties and legal opinions (LLOC /Legislation/English, /Treaty, /LegalOpinion): not built yet
- Consolidated text where LLOC has no .docx: not published (text as published only)

Run by DeveNet S.R.L., La Paz; commercial use allowed; UNOFFICIAL

- LexiVox: newest laws missing (latest Ley N° 1694 of 7 Nov 2025 on 2026-11-10; recent publications are for registered subscribers); texts as published, not consolidated (some codes as 'Texto ordenado')
- Newer Chamber law PDFs (e.g. Ley 1512): scans only, no text (LexiVox id 'BO-L-N1512' has it)
- Senate (senado.gob.bo) and lower courts: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Ustavni sud Bosne i Hercegovine (ustavnisud.ba) – decisions database — https://www.ustavnisud.ba/bs/odluke (caselaw) — unknown: no terms of use on the site (footer 'Copyrights @ 2026 Ustavni sud BiH Sva prava zadržana.'); official court decisions
- Vlada Federacije BiH (fbihvlada.gov.ba) – Hronološki registar zakona (Federation laws as published) — https://fbihvlada.gov.ba/bs/zakoni (legislation) — unknown: no terms of use on the site (footer 'Copyright 2021. Vlada Federacije Bosne i Hercegovine'); official legislative texts
  - ⚠ Federation of BiH entity laws only, as published in Službene novine FBiH (not consolidated; state, Republika Srpska and Brčko laws are not covered).
- Parlamentarna skupština BiH (parlament.ba) – Ustav BiH and Prečišćeni tekstovi zakona (state level) — https://www.parlament.ba/law/Read?categoryId=3 (legislation) — unknown: no terms of use found on the site; official Parliament publication. The consolidated texts are the Parliament's UNOFFICIAL consolidations (Neslužbeni prečišćeni tekst); only the Službeni glasnik BiH text is authentic
  - ⚠ State-level acts: the Constitution (with Amandman I) and the Parliament's unofficial consolidated texts, a selection of state acts (not every act); the authentic text is in Službeni glasnik BiH.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Constitutional Court of BiH decisions (1997-, full text; English for leading cases). Legislation: the Constitution of BiH (with Amandman I), the Parliament's unofficial consolidated state acts (a selection) and Federation of BiH laws as published (1996-). Ordinary courts' case law and the state/RS gazettes are paid. Provisions of the Constitution are returned as whole articles ('II/3' gives Član II).

**Does not reach**

- Ordinary courts' case law (csd.pravosudje.ba): needs registration and is paid
- State-level acts: only the Parliament's selection of unofficial consolidated texts (135 entries, 81 distinct acts) is reached; the full set of acts as adopted sits behind /olaw/OLawDetails* (robots disallow) and Službeni glasnik BiH (paid)
- Republika Srpska laws: Službeni glasnik RS (slglasnik.org) is paid
- Brčko District laws (skupstinabd.ba): free, robots allow; source exists but not built yet
- Consolidated texts: no free official source found (FBiH laws as published only; paragraf.ba is commercial)

**Sources and terms**

- STF – Pesquisa de Jurisprudência (Supremo Tribunal Federal) — https://jurisprudencia.stf.jus.br/ (caselaw) — unknown: no STF terms of use found; judicial decisions are excluded from copyright under Lei 9.610/1998 art. 8, IV
- normas.leg.br (Senado Federal / Câmara dos Deputados) – consolidated federal legislation — https://normas.leg.br/ (legislation) — CC BY 4.0 (declared in every record's license/sdLicense); Senado portal policy: reuse allowed for lawful purposes with attribution; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: STF only (acórdãos, monocratic decisions, súmulas). Legislation: federal norms consolidated per article from normas.leg.br; ids are LexML URNs (aliases cc, cf, cpc, cp, cpp, cdc, clt, ctn). For cp, cpp, cdc, clt and ctn normas.leg.br has only metadata, so their current text comes from the Câmara compilation on legis.senado.leg.br (flat text, no per-version history).

**Does not reach**

- Superior Tribunal de Justiça (STJ): SCON is behind a Cloudflare JS challenge (not touched). Open-data portal (CC-BY) not built: text ZIPs are partial (2026-10-09: 100 texts for 1,293 listed decisions), one file per publication day, no index, robots Crawl-Delay 10
- Other federal and state courts: CNJ DataJud is metadata only and timed out from the UK; court sites not researched yet
- Norms with metadata only in normas.leg.br: text is taken from the Senado-hosted Câmara compilation when it exists; Planalto (usual consolidated text) refuses connections from abroad
- State and municipal legislation: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Конституционен съд (Constitutional Court), constcourt.bg — https://www.constcourt.bg (caselaw) — no licence or terms page; footer says 'съдържанието е обект на авторско право' (content is copyrighted), but official acts of state bodies are excluded from copyright (ЗАПСП art. 4 item 1)
- Народно събрание (National Assembly), parliament.bg API: Constitution and laws as adopted — https://www.parliament.bg/bg/laws (legislation) — no terms page; laws are excluded from copyright (ЗАПСП art. 4 item 1)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Constitutional Court acts (constcourt.bg; its text search is broken, so query words are matched against the act list). Constitution: consolidated (id 'const'). Laws: as adopted/promulgated, never consolidated; search covers the current National Assembly, or 2006 onwards with a year filter (parliament.bg). Supreme courts' sites time out or are robots-blocked.

**Does not reach**

- Supreme Court of Cassation (vks.bg): times out, https and http (2026-11-05 and -06)
- Lower courts (legalacts.justice.bg): https times out, http serves a JavaScript cookie challenge (bot check)
- Supreme Administrative Court: search only via /wp-json/, which robots.txt disallows
- Consolidated laws and codes (the Constitution is covered): no official free source; State Gazette search is a stateful JSF postback, lex.bg is private
- Laws adopted before 2006 (e.g. the base texts of the Penal Code 1968, Obligations and Contracts Act 1950): not in the parliament.bg archive; only their later amending laws are
- Secondary legislation (Council of Ministers decrees, ordinances): not researched yet

- Supremo Tribunal de Justiça de Cabo Verde, jurisprudência (stj.cv) — https://www.stj.cv/index.php/1a-sec-civel/ (caselaw) — '© 2023 Supremo Tribunal de Justiça, All Rights Reserved' footer; no terms-of-use page (checked 2026-11-06)
- JURIS CV – Jurisprudência Cabo-verdiana (Conselho Superior da Magistratura Judicial) — https://jurisprudencia.cv/items (caselaw) — /advertencia: 'As informações que constam deste sítio são públicas e podem ser reproduzidas, desde que a respectiva fonte seja mencionada. No entanto, é proibida a sua utilização para fins comerciais ou ofensivos.' (checked 2026-11-10); no commercial use; needs none (login optional, not used)
  - ⚠ JURIS CV: reproduction allowed with the source named (jurisprudencia.cv, CSMJ); commercial use is forbidden by its terms.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Supremo Tribunal de Justiça (~770 acórdãos, 1994-) and the two Relação courts from JURIS CV (CSMJ, HTML full text, non-commercial terms); Tribunal Constitucional decisions (acórdãos, pareceres, decisões sumárias; 1995-, court=tc) and the stj.cv selection (~360, 2021-, section=...) as PDFs; ~30 core laws (codes, court organic laws, constitutions) as hosted by the TC, not consolidated. The Boletim Oficial's terms forbid copying without INCV permission, so it is not used.

**Does not reach**

- Boletim Oficial (all laws and decrees beyond ~30 TC-hosted texts): INCV terms forbid copying 'sem a prévia autorização'
- STJ: JURIS CV holds ~770 acórdãos (1994-2026) with thin years (e.g. 2014, 2016: 2 each; 1995-2006 almost none) and stj.cv ~360 (2021-); the rest of the STJ's judgments are not published online
- First-instance and appeal court decisions: not researched yet
- Consolidated legislation: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Cour suprême du Cameroun (coursupreme.cm) — https://coursupreme.cm/publication/arret (caselaw) — 'Copyright © 2019 CSC. All Rights Reserved' (site footer); no terms of use or licence page (checked 2026-11-06)
- Présidence de la République du Cameroun (prc.cm), Actes: lois, ordonnances, décrets — https://www.prc.cm/fr/actualites/actes (legislation) — 'Copyright © 2026 Présidence de la République du Cameroun - Tous droits réservés' (site footer); the 'Règles de confidentialité' page is empty; no terms of use (checked 2026-11-06)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: selected Supreme Court judgments (a few dozen) from coursupreme.cm, in French or English. Legislation: laws, ordinances and decrees as signed (not consolidated) from the Presidency's site; newer acts are often scans without text.

**Does not reach**

- Text of newer acts (mostly 2015 onward): prc.cm carries scans only, no text (no OCR)
- Constitutional Council decisions: not published online (no official site found, 2026-11-06)
- Supreme Court judgments beyond the few dozen on coursupreme.cm: not published online
- Lower-court judgments: not published online (minjustice.cm LÉGALIS holds 0, 2026-11-06)
- Consolidated legislation: not published online (prc.cm gives acts as signed; LÉGALIS has 2 laws)

**Sources and terms**

- Supreme Court of Canada judgments (decisions.scc-csc.ca, hosted by Lexum for the Court) — https://decisions.scc-csc.ca (caselaw) — Reasons for judgment: Reproduction of Federal Law Order (SI/97-5), free reproduction incl. commercial if accurate and not presented as official. Headnotes and editorial features (paragraph numbers, lists of authorities): commercial reproduction needs the Court's written permission
- Justice Laws Website, Department of Justice Canada — https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca (legislation) — Open Government Licence – Canada (open.canada.ca XML dataset); also Reproduction of Federal Law Order (not to be presented as official); commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Federal only. Case law = Supreme Court of Canada (Lexum); ids are Lexum item numbers, citations like '2024 SCC 10' also work. Legislation = Justice Laws consolidated Acts and regulations; ids like 'C-46' (Criminal Code), provisions like 'section-718' or 's. 718'. English text; French at the same sites (/fr/, /fra/). No provincial law, no lower courts.

**Does not reach**

- Provincial and territorial legislation: BC Laws API works (not built yet); Ontario e-Laws is a JS app; rest not researched
- Federal Court, Federal Court of Appeal, Tax Court and tribunals: not researched yet
- Provincial courts: CanLII terms prohibit scraping and it serves a JS challenge; official court sites not researched yet
- Constitution Acts 1867-1982: served (law id 'Const'); endnotes (amendment history) left out, page states no 'current to' date; other constitutional instruments (Manitoba Act, Constitution Act 1930 etc.) only in the 1990 /eng/ConstRpt/ report, not built
- Federal legislation search is by title only (no full-text search over section text)
- French text: same sites at /fr/ and /fra/; source exists but not built yet

- Supreme People's Court of the PRC (最高人民法院), guiding cases (指导性案例) — https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan/gengduo/77.html (caselaw) — none published; site footer: 中华人民共和国最高人民法院 版权所有 (all rights reserved)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: SPC guiding cases (指导性案例) only, title search. No legislation: flk.npc.gov.cn robots.txt forbids automated access. China Judgments Online needs a login.

**Does not reach**

- Laws and regulations (flk.npc.gov.cn): robots.txt disallows all and bans '任何自动化工具、脚本、爬虫程序'. Not available through this server; open https://flk.npc.gov.cn in a browser yourself to read the official consolidated texts
- Judgments of all courts (China Judgments Online): needs a login with a mainland phone number
- SPC judicial interpretations and typical cases other than guiding cases: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Corte Constitucional – relatoría (sentencias, full text) — https://www.corteconstitucional.gov.co/relatoria/ (caselaw) — unknown: no terms or licence page found on corteconstitucional.gov.co (2026-11-05)
- datos.gov.co – 'Sentencias proferidas por la Corte Constitucional' (metadata, search) — https://www.datos.gov.co/Justicia-y-Derecho/Sentencias-proferidas-por-la-Corte-Constitucional/v2k4-2t8s (caselaw) — Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (dataset metadata); attribution: Corte Constitucional; commercial use allowed
- Función Pública – Gestor Normativo (consolidated legislation) — https://www.funcionpublica.gov.co/eva/gestornormativo/consulta_avanzada.php (legislation) — no open licence: terms say the content 'podrá ser utilizada teniendo en cuenta las normas que protegen el derecho a la propiedad intelectual' and forbid automated capture/copying without written consent (checked 2026-11-06); off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ Función Pública's terms forbid using 'ningún mecanismo o hardware u otro proceso manual o automático para capturar, monitorizar como propio o copiar' the portal or its content without its written consent. No consent held. The Gestor also says it is informative only and does not vouch for a norm's current validity (vigencia).
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Corte Constitucional sentencias (C, T, SU) since 1992, full text. Search is NOT by subject or full text: it runs only over the Court's open metadata (number, magistrate, process), so you need the sentencia number. Legislation: Función Pública's Gestor Normativo, consolidated texts with amendment notes (a selection of norms, not all; no Código Civil); its terms need written consent for automated use (WLM_PERMITTED=co).

**Does not reach**

- Consolidated legislation (Gestor Normativo): terms forbid automated 'capturar ... o copiar'; off unless WLM_PERMITTED=co
- Corte Suprema de Justicia decisions: relatoría hosts answer 403 'Bloqueo por WafPolicy' to our client
- Consejo de Estado decisions: SAMAI robots.txt disallows its search and document pages (/*.aspx?*)
- Norms outside the Gestor (e.g. Código Civil): Senado basedoc says 'Prohibida su reproducción'; SUIN has no endpoint
- Full-text search of Constitutional Court judgments: the Court's buscador API (/API/) is disallowed by robots.txt

**Sources and terms**

- Gaceta Oficial de la República de Cuba (gacetaoficial.gob.cu) — https://www.gacetaoficial.gob.cu/es/normas-juridicas (legislation) — unknown; footer says 'Todos los Derechos Reservados | © DESOFT 2019', no licence or terms page
- Ministerio de Justicia de Cuba (Gaceta Oficial reposts) — https://www.minjus.gob.cu/es/publicaciones/normas_juridicas (legislation) — unknown; site says 'Todos los derechos reservados', no licence or terms page
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation only: the Gaceta Oficial's own norm database and issue PDFs (as published, not consolidated; text layer), plus MINJUS reposts. Id 'Constitución' = the 2019 Constitution as reformed and republished whole in 2025; 'Código Civil' = the site's 2022 updated edition (later amendments not applied). The Gazette site obeys a 10 s crawl delay and often times out from abroad. No case law source.

**Does not reach**

- Case law: Tribunal Supremo terms forbid access 'utilizando medios automatizados'; it has no decision database anyway
- Primary acts: the Gazette's norm database indexes ~103 Leyes and ~340 Decretos-Leyes; older acts appear mostly as later republications, so completeness for pre-2019 in-force acts is unverified (2026-11-10: Leyes 75, 76, 85, 113, 65 are indexed; Ley 41/1983 and Ley 51/1985 are not, and the site's issue archive starts in 1990, so pre-1990 acts never republished are not online). Ley 59/1987 Código Civil is not indexed (served from the site's 2022 updated edition, id 'Código Civil'); Código Penal Ley 151/2022 and Código de las Familias Ley 156/2022 are indexed
- Consolidation: texts as published, amendments not applied (except the Constitution's 2025 republication)
- Norms without a code (mostly pre-2019) open as their whole Gazette issue, not split out

**Sources and terms**

- rozhodnuti.justice.cz (Ministry of Justice) — https://rozhodnuti.justice.cz (caselaw) — unknown: published as open data by the Ministry of Justice (rozhodnuti.justice.cz/opendata), no licence stated; not in the NKOD catalogue
- e-Sbírka (Ministry of the Interior) — https://e-sbirka.gov.cz (legislation) — NKOD terms for the e-Sbírka open data: no copyrighted works, no database rights, no personal data (CC0-equivalent); legal texts are exempt under § 3 of the Czech Copyright Act. The /sbr-cache REST API itself is undocumented; commercial use allowed
- Sbírka soudních rozhodnutí a stanovisek (Nejvyšší soud), sbirka.nsoud.cz — https://sbirka.nsoud.cz (caselaw) — no terms page; court decisions are official works exempt from copyright (§ 3 Czech Copyright Act 121/2000)
- Vyhledávač NSS (Nejvyšší správní soud), vyhledavac.nssoud.cz — https://vyhledavac.nssoud.cz (caselaw) — no terms page; court decisions are official works exempt from copyright (§ 3 Czech Copyright Act 121/2000)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: by default district, regional and high courts (rozhodnuti.justice.cz, since 2020, anonymised). court='NS' searches the Supreme Court's official Sbírka (1919-, ids 'sbirka:25671'); court='NSS' searches the Supreme Administrative Court (ids 'nssoud:786898', the Vyhledávač NSS document id; court='SPRAVNI' adds regional administrative decisions). ECLI:CZ:NS: and ECLI:CZ:NSS: ids resolve through those sources. Laws: cite as '89/2012 Sb.', provisions as '§ 2'.

**Does not reach**

- Supreme Administrative Court (NSS): regional administrative decisions there (court 'SPRAVNI') are whatever the NSS database holds, completeness unverified
- Constitutional Court (ÚS): nalus.usoud.cz works (HTML search) but not built yet
- Supreme Court (NS): only decisions published in the Sbírka are reachable; the full decision database rozhodnuti.nsoud.cz has robots.txt 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' (only DG_JUSTICE_CRAWLER allowed), so it is not used
- Lower-court decisions before 2020: rozhodnuti.justice.cz starts in 2020; older sources not researched yet
- Regional and municipal regulations: not researched yet

- TSE judgments 2012-2020: on tse.do WordPress pages; source works but not built yet

- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: Case law: Corte Constitucional (2008 onwards), full-text search, full text from the signed PDF. No legislation: no official source offers per-norm text without login or OCR.

**Does not reach**

- Legislation: Registro Oficial's site search (?s=) matches edition summaries only and returns whole gazette PDFs, no per-norm text or consolidation; its REST API needs authorization
- Laws via Asamblea Nacional 'Leyes aprobadas': the gazette law pages are scans only, no text
- Constitution: Asamblea Nacional's text-layer PDF (constitucion_de_bolsillo.pdf) is the 2011 edition, stale (later amendments missing), so not wired (2026-11-10)
- Regulations (gob.ec/regulaciones): needs a login
- Corte Nacional de Justicia: busquedasentencias.cortenacional.gob.ec sends a reCAPTCHA v3 token (X-reCAPTCHA-Token) with every search call; Gaceta Judicial buscador answers HTTP 500 (2026-11-10)
- Lower-court decisions: not researched yet
- Former Tribunal Constitucional decisions (before 2008): not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Riigi Teataja (State Gazette, Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs) — https://www.riigiteataja.ee (legislation) — Legal acts are not protected by copyright (Copyright Act § 5 p 1); RT publishes all acts as XML open data (RT FAQ '9. Avaandmed'). RT Act § 12(1): texts shown elsewhere must refer to the Riigi Teataja text.; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Consolidated legislation in Estonian from Riigi Teataja; ids are RT version ids ('120062026018'), provisions '§ 5' / '§ 11¹'. English translations (unofficial) are linked where RT has one. No case law here: robots.txt closes the court-decision routes; look up Supreme Court (Riigikohus) judgments on the court's own site, www.riigikohus.ee (Lahendid), or the courts' decision search at www.kohus.ee, by hand.

**Does not reach**

- Case law (Supreme Court and all courts; read them at www.riigikohus.ee / www.kohus.ee yourself): robots.txt disallows RT's decision routes and rikos.rik.ee ('Disallow: /')
- About 5,600 old acts (personal data): robots.txt disallows their /akt/ pages
- English translations of acts: linked only, text not served; source works but not built
- Local government regulations: not researched yet

_Court and legislation lists drafted 2026-11-07; references: https://curia.europa.eu/jcms/jcms/Jo2_6999/en/_

**Sources and terms**

- Publications Office CELLAR (EUR-Lex data): SPARQL + REST — https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql (caselaw, legislation) — EU legal documents reusable under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU (commercial or non-commercial reuse, acknowledge source, do not distort); EUR-Lex metadata CC0; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: EUR-Lex data via CELLAR. Ids are CELEX numbers (32016R0679 = GDPR, 62014CJ0362 = Schrems); ECLI accepted for decisions. Search covers titles only.

**Does not reach**

- Full-text search of documents: EUR-Lex SOAP webservice needs a free account we have not signed up for (titles only)
- Texts in languages other than English (French fallback): CELLAR serves them; not built
- InfoCuria case files and pending cases: Angular SPA with no public API found
- EUR-Lex website itself: behind an AWS WAF JS challenge (bot check)
- Civil Service Tribunal decisions (2005-2016): search covers cj/gc only; get_decision by CELEX (6…FJ…) untested
- Treaties and Charter (sector 1): served by CELEX id (current: 12016M/TXT = TEU, 12016E/TXT = TFEU, 12016P/TXT = Charter; doc_type=treaty lists all consolidated versions). No in-force flag for old versions (CELLAR marks them all in force); protocols and declarations are inside the TEU/TFEU text, article labels repeat there (a label resolves to the main treaty first); accession treaties and amending treaties (sector 1 works without /TXT) not searched
- International agreements (sector 2): not built

**Sources and terms**

- Finlex avoin data (Ministry of Justice / Legal Register Centre) — https://opendata.finlex.fi/finlex/avoindata/v1 (legislation) — CC BY 4.0 (Finlex FAQ); statutes themselves are public domain (Copyright Act 404/1961 s. 9); commercial use allowed
- Finlex website (www.finlex.fi), KKO/KHO published decisions — https://www.finlex.fi/fi/oikeuskaytanto (caselaw) — public, 'no restrictions on use' (Finlex FAQ); court decisions are public domain (Copyright Act s. 9); no personal-data misuse; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Consolidated legislation (Finnish, Swedish via '/swe' on the id) from the Finlex open data API; KKO/KHO published decisions from finlex.fi (precedents by default; filter kind= for other decisions, leave grants and short summaries). Ids: '39-001/1889', 'ECLI:FI:KKO:2025:1', 'KKO:muut:2025:1424', 'KHO:lyhyt:2021:H4774'.

**Does not reach**

- Other courts (courts of appeal, district, administrative and special courts): not researched yet
- KKO/KHO: Finlex publishes only selected decisions (precedents plus chosen 'other' decisions, KKO leave grants from 2025, KHO short summaries 1946-2021); unpublished decisions are not reachable. Search matches the list keywords, not full text; some KKO 'other' entries carry only a short summary
- Case law in the Finlex open data API: not published (every judgment type 404s); read from finlex.fi instead
- Original Statute Book texts, authority regulations and the Treaty Series: adapter queries consolidated statutes (statute-consolidated) only
- Åland legislation: not researched yet

  - ⚠ Pseudonymised decisions: do not try to re-identify people; profiling, comparing or rating judges and court clerks is a criminal offence (COJ art. L111-13).

  - ⚠ Légifrance API data are not legally binding: only the signed PDF Journal officiel is (CGU VI.1). Decisions: profiling, comparing or rating judges is a criminal offence (COJ art. L111-13, CJA art. L10).
- Tools: none
- Notes: Inactive: needs a free PISTE account. Set WLM_FR_PISTE_CLIENT_ID and WLM_FR_PISTE_CLIENT_SECRET (OAuth client credentials of a piste.gouv.fr app subscribed to Judilibre and Légifrance).

- Tribunaux administratifs: Légifrance holds only a small selection; the full set is on opendata.justice-administrative.fr (not built)

- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation: Matsne (Georgian consolidated text; English translations for many acts via language='en'). Case law: ECD holds only 2018-01 to 2020-04; Constitutional Court via court='constitutional'.

**Does not reach**

- Supreme Court decisions after April 2020: supremecourt.ge robots.txt disallows /ka/getCases*

- English text of acts without a Legislative Herald translation: not published online

**Sources and terms**

- NeuRIS – Rechtsinformationsportal des Bundes (API, trial service) — https://docs.rechtsinformationen.bund.de (caselaw) — No licence stated; court decisions are public-domain official works (§ 5 UrhG); off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ NeuRIS is a trial service whose robots.txt disallows all automated access (Disallow: /). Get explicit permission from the operator (DigitalService / BMJV) before relying on it.
- Bundesfinanzhof – Entscheidungen online (bundesfinanzhof.de) — https://www.bundesfinanzhof.de/de/entscheidungen/entscheidungen-online/ (caselaw) — Impressum: decisions are official works (§ 5 UrhG), free to use
- Gesetze im Internet (Bundesamt für Justiz / BMJV) — https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de (legislation) — No licence stated; statutes are public-domain official works (§ 5 UrhG)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Federal level only. Case law: NeuRIS (all federal courts, needs WLM_PERMITTED=de); otherwise the Federal Fiscal Court (BFH) from its own site, 1 request/min. Legislation: current consolidated texts from gesetze-im-internet.de; ids are GII slugs ('bgb', 'gg', 'stgb').

**Does not reach**

- BGH, BVerfG, BVerwG, BAG, BSG, BPatG case law: only via NeuRIS, whose robots.txt says 'Disallow: /'; off unless WLM_PERMITTED=de (needs permission)
- Federal courts' own sites (checked 2026-11-10): BGH and BSG searches sit under robots-disallowed /SiteGlobals/; BVerwG search is behind a bot challenge; BAG terms need permission for any use of texts/database; rechtsprechung-im-internet.de robots 'Disallow: /'
- BFH without permission: only decisions the court publishes online (V and NV), 2010 on; slow (robots Crawl-Delay 60 = 1 request/min)
- Land (state) court decisions (OLG, LG, AG, Land admin courts): no official API; per-Land portals not researched yet
- Land (state) legislation of the 16 Länder: per-Land portals not researched yet
- Earlier versions of federal laws: gesetze-im-internet.de serves the current version only

**Sources and terms**

- Άρειος Πάγος – Νομολογία (Supreme Civil and Criminal Court) — https://www.areiospagos.gr/nomologia/apofaseis.asp (caselaw) — Areios Pagos terms: further use allowed on the sole condition that texts are not altered or distorted and that the source and publication date are cited; commercial use allowed
- Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο – Αναζήτηση ΦΕΚ (Government Gazette, Presidency of the Government) — https://search.et.gr/el/ (legislation) — Terms of use (search.et.gr/el/oroi-xrisis): personal, informational, non-commercial use; no commercial use; off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ search.et.gr terms allow only personal, informational, non-commercial use and forbid reproduction for non-personal use and conversion/copying/transmission of its content without permission; hosting this for others needs the Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο's explicit permission. To check legislation yourself, search the gazette at https://search.et.gr/el/.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Areios Pagos only (2006 onward, anonymised), searched by number ('1/2020'), year ('2024', large), or words matched to the subject index's fixed headings (first 3 matching headings; index mostly 2007–2010); no free text. Legislation: ΦΕΚ gazette text as published, NOT consolidated; ids are ΦΕΚ labels ('Α 137/2019'), laws also as 'ν. 4624/2019'. Council of State: bot-challenged, not covered.

**Does not reach**

- ΦΕΚ legislation when hosted for others: needs permission (terms: 'personal, informational, non-commercial use')
- Council of State (administrative) case law: bot check / blocks our client
- Consolidated legislation: not published online officially (only the ΦΕΚ gazette as published)
- ΦΕΚ issues before ~2000: scans only, no text (no OCR)
- Areios Pagos before 2006, and appeal/first-instance courts: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Biblioteca Virtual del Tribunal Superior de Cuentas (TSC) – laws, codes, regulations and decrees as published (PDF, mostly La Gaceta copies) — https://www.tsc.gob.hn/biblioteca/ (legislation) — unknown: no licence or terms of use on www.tsc.gob.hn; robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/ (checked 2026-11-06)
- ENAG – La Gaceta Digital (Diario Oficial de la República de Honduras) — https://www.enag.gob.hn/index.php/gaceta-digital (legislation) — unknown: no licence or terms page; the site says a Congreso–ENAG agreement gives 'acceso universal y gratuito a la legislación hondureña' published in La Gaceta (checked 2026-11-10)
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Laws, codes, regulations and decrees from the Tribunal Superior de Cuentas' Biblioteca Virtual: texts as published (often La Gaceta pages), not consolidated; reforms are separate PDFs. Whole La Gaceta issues 2015- from ENAG (id 'YYYYMMDD-NNNNN', found with filter gaceta_month). No case law: the Poder Judicial (CEDIJ) site was unreachable.

**Does not reach**

- Case law (Poder Judicial / CEDIJ): site down / unreachable (TCP timeout from the UK, 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-10)
- Consolidated texts: not in the TSC library (reforms are separate PDFs); Congreso site has a bad TLS cert / timeout (2026-11-06; intermittent, mostly timeouts 2026-11-10)
- Older laws in the library: scans only, no text (no OCR)
- Primary acts not in the TSC library: only via whole La Gaceta issues on ENAG from 2015 (found by month, matched on ENAG's issue summary); pre-2015 Gazette not listed (ENAG's keyword search is imprecise, not used)
- Constitution: the TSC copy is the 1982 text with reforms to 2004; later reforms only as decrees in La Gaceta, not applied
- La Gaceta issues: articles indexed for the issue's first norm only; read others with get_legislation_text

- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: ICSID investment arbitration cases (World Bank). Search covers case number, parties and status; get_decision on a case number gives the case record and its published decisions; '<case no>#<doc>' gives an award's text (from PDF). Non-commercial reuse only.

- Decisions listed as published but not on the ICSID website: not published online by ICSID (titles only)

_Court and legislation lists drafted 2026-11-07; references: https://indian-high-court-judgments.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/?list-type=2&prefix=data/pdf/year=2025/&delimiter=/_

**Sources and terms**

- India Code (Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice; run by NIC) — https://indiacode.gov.in/ (legislation) — restrictive (Term of Use + Copyright Policy, both 'Last updated June 22, 2026', read 2026-11-05 from the site's JS bundle): personal, non-commercial use only; 'Not use any automated means to access the Portal for any purpose without our express written permission'; 'Use of API data requires written authorization'; 'Data obtained through APIs must not be cached, stored, or redistributed without permission'. No written permission held. Whether s. 52(1)(q) Copyright Act 1957 overrides this for the Acts: unverified; no commercial use; AI use opted out; needs none technically (anonymous REST API), but the terms require written authorization from the Legislative Department for API/automated use; off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ India Code's terms forbid automated access and API use without the Legislative Department's express written permission, and allow personal, non-commercial use only. Use this source only if you hold that permission. Without it, read the Act text by hand on indiacode.gov.in (search the Act's title; the terms allow personal, non-commercial use) and cite the section there; this tool cannot fetch it.
- Indian Supreme Court Judgments (AWS Open Data; Dattam Labs mirror of the Supreme Court's e-SCR) — https://registry.opendata.aws/indian-supreme-court-judgments/ (caselaw) — dataset CC BY 4.0 (AWS Open Data registry, read 2026-11-10); the judgments themselves are not copyright-protected for reproduction (s. 52(1)(q)(iv) Copyright Act 1957); attribute the Supreme Court of India / e-SCR; commercial use allowed; needs none (public S3 bucket, no AWS account); UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ S.C.R.-reported judgments only; the official copy is at scr.sci.gov.in.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Central and state Acts from India Code, section by section (off unless WLM_PERMITTED). Law ids are India Code act ids (AC_CEN_...), or '9 of 1872' for central Acts. Supreme Court: S.C.R.-reported judgments 1950 to date from an unofficial AWS Open Data mirror of e-SCR; search one year at a time (parties, citation, coram, headnote).

**Does not reach**

- Legislation (India Code, all Acts): terms forbid automated use ('Not use any automated means'); needs written permission
- Constitution: legislative.gov.in (official PDFs) answers our User-Agent with an Akamai 403; Constitute Project text is non-commercial and flags a 2024 amendment not incorporated; not built
- Supreme Court, unreported judgments: not in e-SCR or the AWS mirror; official sci.gov.in judgment search is behind a CAPTCHA
- Supreme Court full-text search: the mirror has no search index; search matches parties, citations, coram and headnote within one year
- High Courts (AWS Open Data, unofficial, CC BY 4.0): source exists, not built
- Schedules of Acts: not published online as text in India Code's API (SCHEDULE items carry no text)
- Subordinate legislation (rules, regulations, notifications): not researched yet

Texts are PDF-only behind a bot challenge, so no full text: metadata and PDF links. Non-commercial use only.

- Permanent Court of International Justice (1922-1946) records: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Irish Statute Book (eISB, Office of the Attorney General) — https://www.irishstatutebook.ie (legislation) — Oireachtas (Open Data) PSI Licence, which incorporates CC BY 4.0 (attribution required). Search uses the site's own Solr title index (undocumented); texts use the documented ELI XML/HTML; commercial use allowed
- Law Reform Commission Revised Acts — https://revisedacts.lawreform.ie (legislation) — Legislative text: Oireachtas (Open Data) PSI Licence (CC BY 4.0); LRC annotations: CC BY 4.0. Attribute the Houses of the Oireachtas and the LRC separately; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation only (Constitution, Acts and S.I.s, English). Ids are ELI paths like '2014/act/30'; the Constitution is 'cons' (provisions 'article/40', 'preamble'); provisions 'section/2', 'schedule/1'. Pre-1922 Acts as published on eISB. Acts use the LRC Revised Act (consolidated) when one exists, else the text as enacted; each text says which. S.I.s: as made, full text only. No case law: judgments.courts.ie robots.txt disallows all crawling. Employment decisions (unfair dismissal etc.) are published by the Workplace Relations Commission (workplacerelations.ie) and the Labour Court; neither is wired here.

**Does not reach**

- Case law (judgments.courts.ie): robots.txt disallows (`Disallow: /`); BAILII Ireland: bot check / blocks our client
- Employment decisions (unfair dismissal etc.): Workplace Relations Commission and Labour Court, workplacerelations.ie (not wired; search there directly)
- Consolidated text of Acts the LRC has not revised: not published online (eISB has them as enacted only)
- Pre-1922 Acts not revised by the LRC: text as published on eISB, later amendments/repeals not shown
- Private Acts: open by id ('2023/prv/1') but not in the eISB search index (listed at /isbc/patoc.html)
- Constitution: English text only (the Irish text, which prevails, is not wired)
- Statutory Instruments: as made, full text only (no XML, no TOC); consolidated S.I.s not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Knesset OData (ParliamentInfo) – Israeli law database (official) — https://knesset.gov.il/Odata/ParliamentInfo.svc/ (legislation) — no licence stated; laws are not copyright-protected (Copyright Act 2007, s. 6)
- Sefer HaChukim (ספר החוקים, Reshumot) as-published PDFs on fs.knesset.gov.il (official) — https://fs.knesset.gov.il/ (legislation) — no licence stated; laws are not copyright-protected (Copyright Act 2007, s. 6)
  - ⚠ Text is machine-read from the PDF's text layer: scans (roughly pre-2005) carry OCR with about 1-5% misread words, and numbers/punctuation or margin headings can land out of place; check the linked PDF before quoting.
- Open Law Book (ספר החוקים הפתוח), Hebrew Wikisource – non-official (crowd-maintained, Wikimedia Foundation) — https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/ספר_החוקים_הפתוח (legislation) — CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Terms of Use s. 7); commercial use allowed; UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ Consolidated text is volunteer-maintained on Wikisource, not an official version; check the Knesset gazette PDFs before relying on it.
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation only, in Hebrew: Knesset law database (official metadata, id = IsraelLawID) + consolidated text from the non-official Open Law Book on Wikisource + official as-published text from the Sefer HaChukim PDFs (ids '<IsraelLawID>/original' and '<IsraelLawID>/<BillID>' for each amending law). No case law: the court sites block automated access and require a signed undertaking.

**Does not reach**

- Case law (Supreme Court sites): blocks our client (unauthorised-activity page); bulk access needs permission (signed undertaking)
- Official consolidated text: not published online free (Nevo/Takdin are paid); the consolidated text here is non-official Wikisource; the official text is per publication (original law + each amending law), except the few laws the Knesset re-published as נוסח משולב
- Official gazette text quality: read from the PDF text layer; pre-~2005 scans are OCR (about 1-5% misread words in samples), and later born-digital PDFs can misplace numbers, punctuation and margin headings; sections are not split (pages only)
- Mandate-era ordinances (פקודה): the official PDF is the Dinei Medinat Israel [נוסח חדש] republication where the Knesset database holds it (KNS_DocumentLaw); scanned OCR, same quality caveats
- Search covers law names only (Knesset OData), not the text; regulations (תקנות, Kovetz HaTakanot on gov.il, Cloudflare-walled): not covered

  - ⚠ ITLOS terms: personal, non-commercial use only, acknowledge the Tribunal as source. Judgment/order texts (ITLOS Reports) need the Registrar's permission to reproduce, so only the case record and PDF links are given here.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: ITLOS cases (list of ~36). Search matches case number and title; get_decision gives the case overview and every document (orders, judgments, advisory opinions, pleadings) with date and PDF link. Judgment texts are not reproduced (ITLOS terms). Statute, Rules of the Tribunal and UNCLOS are not served here; the official texts are listed at https://www.itlos.org/en/main/basic-texts-and-other-documents/ (Statute = Annex VI to UNCLOS).

**Does not reach**

- Statute, Rules of the Tribunal (ITLOS/8) and UNCLOS: no legislation source here; read the official texts at https://www.itlos.org/en/main/basic-texts-and-other-documents/
- Text of judgments, orders and advisory opinions (ITLOS Reports): needs permission (Registrar's written permission)
- Text of pleadings (Pleadings series): needs permission (Registrar's written permission)
- Site search (ke-search) and ?id= URLs: robots.txt disallows; search matches case number and title only

**Sources and terms**

- Find Case Law, The National Archives (UK): Judicial Committee of the Privy Council judgments — https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (caselaw) — Open Justice Licence v2.0: free re-use incl. commercial; 'computational analysis' (programmatic bulk searching to identify, extract or enrich records) needs a separate, free licence; commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- Supreme Court of Jamaica judgments (supremecourt.gov.jm) — https://supremecourt.gov.jm/content/judgments (caselaw) — © the Court; no licence stated. Terms of Use page has a privacy policy and disclaimer only ('makes the information on this website available as a public service'); silent on reuse and automated access (read 2026-11-05)
- Court of Appeal of Jamaica judgments (courtofappeal.gov.jm) — https://courtofappeal.gov.jm/content/judgmentsmemoranda-reasonsendorsements (caselaw) — © the Court; no licence stated. Terms of Use page has a privacy policy and disclaimer only ('makes the information on this website available as a public service'); silent on reuse and automated access (read 2026-11-05)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: Privy Council (final court) judgments in Jamaican appeals, Nov 2009 on, full-text search, from Find Case Law (UK National Archives). Supreme Court and Court of Appeal judgments from the courts' own sites (mostly 1990s-; older PDFs are often scans without text). Search matches party names / title and neutral citation, not full text. No legislation: the Laws of Jamaica site (laws.moj.gov.jm) is down for maintenance (HTTP 503, 2026-11-10).

**Does not reach**

- Privy Council judgments before Nov 2009: only on BAILII (no API, forbids scraping); Find Case Law's UKPC collection starts 2009
- Privy Council country filter is heuristic (Find Case Law has no country field): title '(Jamaica)' or header 'From the Court of Appeal of Jamaica'; a judgment with neither is missed (e.g. [2017] UKPC 21, header 'From the Court of Appeal Jamaica')
- Consolidated legislation and the Constitution (Laws of Jamaica, laws.moj.gov.jm): site down, HTTP 503 'Website Maintenance Notice' pointing to LIPJ (http and https, 2026-11-10)
- LIPJ portal (lipj.gov.jm, ~18k acts/regulations): needs permission (terms §3 'lawful, non-commercial purposes'; §6 no exploiting portal functionality without prior written consent)
- As-passed Acts PDFs (japarliament.gov.jm): source exists but not built yet (no consolidated text, Crawl-delay 15)
- Older judgments: scans only, no text (no OCR)
- Parish and other lower courts: not researched yet

Law 04/L-065 art. 12 excluded official materials from copyright (successor law 08/L-205 not checked)
- Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette, Office of the Prime Minister), gzk.rks-gov.net — https://gzk.rks-gov.net (legislation) — no licence or terms of use published; footer 'Copyright ZKM - MAP © 2022'. Law 04/L-065 art. 12 excluded laws and official materials from copyright (successor law 08/L-205 not checked)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Constitutional Court only (2009-), sq/en/sr. Legislation: Official Gazette, Albanian: Constitution, codes and laws as published; the Gazette's consolidated versions are separate acts titled '(KONSOLIDUAR)'.

**Does not reach**

- Ordinary-court case law (gjyqesori-rks.org): 403 to our client; robots.txt sets Content-Signal ai-train=no
- Consolidated laws: the Gazette has acts as published; it has consolidated only some laws (158 '(KONSOLIDUAR)' acts on 2026-11-10, all reachable: search 'konsoliduar'); for the rest read the act with its amending acts
- Serbian and English texts of legislation: the site's language is a per-session switch; not built yet
- Old Constitutional Court documents with no text in any language: scans only, no text
- Kosovo Specialist Chambers (repository.scp-ks.org): not built; its legal notice allows reuse only for private, information or education use and asks written permission for anything else

**Sources and terms**

- Official Gazette of the Lao PDR (Ministry of Justice): search index — https://www.laoofficialgazette.gov.la/ (legislation) — free access for all users; altering copied texts is a criminal offence; republishing as books needs Ministry of Justice permission
  - ⚠ Titles and metadata only: the Gazette's texts are scanned Lao PDFs (no text layer); open the PDF. Copied texts must not be altered; printing them as books needs Ministry of Justice permission.
- Tools: search_legislation
- Notes: Legislation index only: title search over the Official Gazette (laws, decrees, decisions, ~2,600 acts, Lao), with links to the scanned PDFs. No text, no case law.

**Does not reach**

- Full text of all legislation: scans only, no text (Gazette PDFs are images; no OCR); titles and metadata only
- Case law (People's Supreme Court): site down / unreachable (spc.gov.la does not resolve, peoplecourt.gov.la timed out, 2026-11-06)
- English versions: not published online (English PDF column empty in every row seen)

No legislation: likumi.lv search is closed to robots and re-use needs Latvijas Vēstnesis' written consent. For statute text (Darba likums, Civillikums, etc.) read it yourself at https://likumi.lv (the official consolidated texts; search there by title).

- Parliament texts (titania.saeima.lv): robots.txt disallows (Disallow: /)
- Decisions before 2007: not in the portal (anonymised decisions published from 2007); older ones not researched yet
- Constitutional Court (Satversmes tiesa) judgments: not available here; this source holds the ordinary, administrative and Supreme Court decisions only (the Court publishes its own judgments at satv.tiesa.gov.lv)

- Lilex – Gesetzesdatenbank des Fürstentums Liechtenstein (Rechtsdienst der Regierung) — https://www.gesetze.li (legislation) — unknown (no licence or terms of use published; Impressum/Datenschutz are silent on reuse)
- Fürstlicher Oberster Gerichtshof – Entscheidungen (www.ogh.li) — https://www.ogh.li/entscheidungen-des-ogh (caselaw) — Impressum: site texts are copyright; commercial use needs prior written permission (court decisions themselves are official works); no commercial use
  - ⚠ ogh.li Impressum: commercial use of the site's texts needs the court's prior written permission.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Consolidated law in German from gesetze.li, ids are LGBl-Nr (1921.015 = Verfassung, 1003.001 = ABGB). Case law: Supreme Court (OGH) decisions 2020-2025 as published on ogh.li (about 230; search by case number, keyword tag or cited norm, full text via PDF).

**Does not reach**

- Case law of all courts incl. the full OGH archive before mid-2020 (gerichtsentscheide.li, gerichtsentscheidungen.li): robots.txt disallows (Disallow: /, rechecked 2026-11-10)
- OGH on ogh.li: a selection only (decisions the court chose to post, 2020-2025, none for 2026 yet); search is over case number, tags and cited norms, not the full text
- Earlier versions of a law (version list on gesetze.li): source exists and works but not built yet (current version only)

**Sources and terms**

- Legilux — Journal officiel du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg (Ministère d'État, Service central de législation): JOLux SPARQL + Akoma Ntoso XML — https://legilux.public.lu/ (legislation) — CC BY 4.0 (jolux:license on every file; data.public.lu dataset 'Legilux - Journal officiel'), © Ministère d'État — Service central de législation; commercial use allowed
- data.public.lu — Cour de cassation decisions (Administration judiciaire), yearly ZIPs of PDFs read member by member with HTTP Range — https://data.public.lu/fr/datasets/cour-de-cassation-1/ (caselaw) — CC BY-ND 4.0 (stated on the dataset page): reproduce unaltered, credit Administration judiciaire; the official search remains justice.public.lu; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: National legislation in French: consolidated codes and laws (~1,400) and the original Mémorial text of every other act. Law id = Legilux ELI, e.g. eli/etat/leg/code/civil or eli/etat/leg/loi/2018/08/01/a686. Case law: only the Cour de cassation, published PDFs 1971-today, listed by year/date/case number (no full-text search; see gaps).

**Does not reach**

- Cour de cassation full-text search: the source is yearly ZIPs of PDFs with no index, so search lists by year/date/case number and opens a text only for <= 40 candidates (narrow with date_from/date_to); text of pre-2000 decisions is noisy OCR
- Other courts (justice.public.lu): bot check (FriendlyCaptcha); administrative courts (ja.public.lu) answer 403; the Tribunal d'arrondissement ZIPs on data.public.lu are not wired
- Consolidated text of acts outside the ~1,400 consolidated ones: not published online (original Mémorial text served)

No case law: court judgment hosts sit behind Cloudflare challenges.

**Does not reach**

- Case law (Supreme Court, High Court, lower courts): Cloudflare challenge blocks our client (2026-11-06)
- English texts: not published (MvLaw's English switch is off; Dhivehi only)
- Acts before 2008 that MvLaw has not entered: the Gazette's law list starts 2008-2009 and no other official full-text source was found
- Gazette texts: as published, not consolidated; provisions only per PDF page (the PDF text layer garbles article numbering)
- Word-search hits beyond the first 10: the source ignores the page parameter

**Sources and terms**

- Find Case Law, The National Archives (UK): Judicial Committee of the Privy Council judgments — https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (caselaw) — Open Justice Licence v2.0: free re-use incl. commercial; 'computational analysis' (programmatic bulk searching to identify, extract or enrich records) needs a separate, free licence; commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- Supreme Court of Mauritius website (supremecourt.govmu.org): judgment search (subordinate courts) and legislation library — https://supremecourt.govmu.org (caselaw, legislation) — © Supreme Court of Mauritius; Terms and Conditions §3: material 'may be reproduced free of charge in any format or medium provided it is reproduced accurately and not used in a misleading context; and the source of the material must be identified and the copyright status acknowledged'; off unless WLM_PERMITTED
  - ⚠ Personal use only: the site says it is 'maintained for your personal use and viewing'. Reproduce accurately with attribution: '© Supreme Court of Mauritius'. The site's texts are for convenience of reference; official versions are in the Mauritius Reports / SCJ and the Government Gazette. Currently OFF by default (robots.txt Disallow: / since 2026-11-10): subordinate-court judgments and the 2024+ library are unavailable.
- Revised Laws of Mauritius, Attorney General's Office (attorneygeneral.govmu.org) — https://attorneygeneral.govmu.org/Pages/Laws%20of%20Mauritius/A-Z%20Acts/ActsAZ.aspx (legislation) — © Government of Mauritius; terms of use: copies may be made, but the texts should not be published, disseminated or incorporated 'for commercial use without the prior approval of the Solicitor General'; no commercial use
  - ⚠ Non-commercial use only without the Solicitor General's prior approval. The site's Revised Laws are updated to 30 June 2017 (some later issues); the authoritative text is the printed Revised Laws. The PDF text layer of some laws (the Constitution, bilingual codes) has stray spaces inside words: check any quotation against the PDF.
- National Assembly of Mauritius (mauritiusassembly.govmu.org): Acts as passed — https://mauritiusassembly.govmu.org/mauritiusassembly/index.php/acts-2/ (legislation) — no reuse terms; disclaimer page only (accuracy not guaranteed, verify with the relevant department)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Privy Council (final court) judgments in Mauritian appeals, Nov 2009 on, full text, from Find Case Law (UK National Archives); subordinate courts (Intermediate, Industrial, District, Rodrigues, Children's Court), 2020 on, OFF by default (the source's robots.txt disallows all automated access since 2026-11-10; court=intermediate etc. fail unless the operator holds the Supreme Court's permission); no Supreme Court (SCJ) judgments are published online by an allowed source. Legislation: the Constitution and ~660 Acts as consolidated in the Revised Laws of Mauritius (Attorney General's Office; updated to June 2017, some later issues); Acts as passed 2009-2023 (National Assembly; 2018 from the AG); Acts, GNs, Bills, Proclamations and Reprints as enacted, 2024 on (Supreme Court library). Amendments after a Revised Laws issue are not merged: read the later amending Acts.

**Does not reach**

- Privy Council judgments before Nov 2009: only on BAILII (no API, forbids scraping); Find Case Law's UKPC collection starts 2009
- Privy Council country filter is heuristic (Find Case Law has no country field): title '(Mauritius)' or header 'From the Supreme Court of Mauritius'; a judgment with neither is missed (e.g. [2016] UKPC 30, [2015] UKPC 14 'From the Court of Appeal of Mauritius')
- Supreme Court (SCJ) judgments: not published in the site's judgment collection (checked 2026-11-06)
- Subordinate-court judgments before 2020: not published online on the site
- Consolidated Acts: the AG's Revised Laws stop at 30 June 2017 for most Acts (a few later issues); later amendments are only in the amending Acts as passed; no official up-to-date consolidation online. Whether the AG's A-Z list holds every Act in force is unverified (~660 titles); title search only (AG search API returns 500)
- Acts as passed: the National Assembly tables miss some PDFs (rows without links); 2018 Acts from the AG list have no titles (number only); Acts as passed before 2009 not online (their text is in the Revised Laws)
- MauritiusLII judgments: robots.txt disallows /judgments/ and sets Content-Signal ai-input=no

- Ustavni sud Crne Gore (ustavnisud.me) – Sudska arhiva — https://www.ustavnisud.me/ustavnisud/arhiva.php (caselaw) — unknown: no terms of use or licence on the site (footer '© Ustavni sud Crne Gore. Sva prava zadržana.'); official court decisions
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: Case law only: Constitutional Court of Montenegro decisions (1964-) from the Court's archive. Search single words (diacritics optional). Ordinary courts (sudovi.me) block automated access; the Official Gazette shows acts only as page images. No legislation text here: laws (e.g. Krivični zakonik, Zakon o radu) are only in the Official Gazette as page scans (sluzbenilist.me) or as paid consolidated text (regis.sluzbenilist.me); read them there.

**Does not reach**

- Ordinary courts' case law (sudovi.me): Cloudflare blocks our client (403) and robots.txt disallows AI agents
- Legislation as published (Official Gazette, sluzbenilist.me): scans only, acts shown as page images (JPEG), no text
- Parliament's laws site (zakoni.skupstina.me): session agendas with bills (Predlog zakona) since 2013, as proposed, no constitution, no consolidation; Content-Signal ai-train=no (2026-11-10)
- Consolidated legislation (regis.sluzbenilist.me): paid; terms forbid copying ('strogo je zabranjeno svako kopiranje')
- Older Constitutional Court decisions filed as PDF scans: scans only, no text

All Rights Reserved.'; needs none (public JSON API behind the site's JavaScript app)

- Notes: Case law: ~6,900 law-report rulings (Supreme Court and predecessors, 1920s to 2022; English before independence, Burmese after) as Unicode text, from the court's RCMS. Laws: a small selection (~30) of laws, court procedures and amending laws posted by the Supreme Court, incl. the Code of Civil Procedure and Code of Criminal Procedure in English. No full statute book is reachable (MLIS offline, Hluttaw JavaScript-only).

**Does not reach**

- Full statute book (Myanmar Law Information System, mlis.gov.mm): site down / unreachable (timeout, 2026-11-06)

- Rulings after Dec 2022: none published; the court's own law-report list (unionsupremecourt.gov.mm/ruling) ends with the 2022 volume and RCMS likewise (checked 2026-11-10)
- Unreported Supreme Court commercial judgments (Commercial Judgment System, cjs.usc.gov.mm: 148 of ~316, up to 2026): recent ones scans only, older text garbled (checked 2026-11-10); not built
- Burmese laws in legacy-font PDFs: broken text layer, refused (no usable text)

**Sources and terms**

- rechtspraak.nl (case law) — https://uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl (caselaw) — Public Domain Mark 1.0 (data.overheid.nl dataset 'Uitspraken rechtspraak.nl'); judgments carry no copyright (Auteurswet art. 11); commercial use allowed
- wetten.overheid.nl / BWB (legislation) — https://wetten.overheid.nl (legislation) — CC0 1.0 (data.overheid.nl dataset 'Basis Wetten Bestand'); legislation carries no copyright (Auteurswet art. 11); commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Decision ids are ECLIs (ECLI:NL:HR:2024:123). Law ids are BWB-ids (BWBR0005289 = Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6; BW articles are labelled '6:2'). Search in Dutch; search_legislation matches title words only and looks at the first 100 SRU records.

**Does not reach**

- Local and provincial regulations (CVDR / lokale regelgeving): not researched yet
- Staatsblad, Staatscourant and parliamentary papers: not researched yet
- Treaties: not built as such; BWB search has no type filter, so treaty records (BWBV) can appear in results
- Case-law search by arbitrary date range: the source offers only four preset windows

**Sources and terms**

- Supreme Court of Nigeria (supremecourt.gov.ng) – Judgments — https://supremecourt.gov.ng/judgment (caselaw) — unknown: no terms of use or licence published on the site
- National Assembly of Nigeria (nass.gov.ng) – Acts as passed — https://nass.gov.ng/documents/magazine (legislation) — unknown: no terms of use published (the footer 'Terms' link is empty)
- Nigerian Investment Promotion Commission (nipc.gov.ng) – Acts — https://nipc.gov.ng/external-resources/document-types/act (legislation) — unknown: no terms of use published
- PLAC Laws of Nigeria (lawsofnigeria.placng.org): unrevised LFN 2004 (unofficial) — https://lawsofnigeria.placng.org/ (legislation) — unknown: no terms page; footer '(c) Copyright Policy and Legal Advocacy Centre 2026'; an NGO print of the official 2004 revision, law as at 31 Dec 2002; UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ PLAC's 2004 Laws of the Federation: unrevised, law as at 31 Dec 2002 (later Acts and amendments are missing); an NGO copy, not the Government Printer's.
- FAOLEX (FAO) – Constitution of Nigeria 1999, consolidated to 2023 (PLAC print) — https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/nig164561.pdf (legislation) — FAO terms: may be copied and downloaded for private study, research, teaching and non-commercial products or services, with acknowledgement of the source; no commercial use; UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ Constitution text is PLAC's April 2023 consolidation hosted by FAOLEX, not the Government Printer's; non-commercial use only under FAO's terms.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Supreme Court of Nigeria judgments from the Court's own site: full text for legacy judgments (1960s-2012); recent ones (2023+) are scanned PDFs (metadata + link). Legislation: the 1999 Constitution consolidated to 2023 (unofficial PLAC print on FAOLEX) plus ~200 Acts as passed from the National Assembly and NIPC; title search only.

**Does not reach**

- Federal legislation: no free consolidated Laws of the Federation online; only ~160 Acts as passed (nass.gov.ng, mostly 2001-2017 and 2025-2026) and 38 investment-related Acts (nipc.gov.ng) are covered, not amended/consolidated, and most principal Acts in LFN 2004 are missing
- Constitution: unofficial PLAC consolidation to the Fifth Alteration (2023); any later alteration is not included (unverified whether there is one)
- Legislation search matches titles only (no full-text search at the sources)
- PLAC 'Laws of Nigeria' (unrevised LFN 2004, 413 Acts listed, unofficial) is wired in (source=plac, or when a default search finds nothing; first load reads 69 index pages): law as at 31 Dec 2002, so Acts and amendments since are missing; licence unknown (no terms page)
- Recent Supreme Court judgments (2023 on): scans only, no text (metadata and PDF link given)
- Supreme Court judgments 2013-2022: not published in the Court's database (legacy to 2012, recent from 2023)
- Court of Appeal (~20 judgments, text only via Google Drive links): not built
- Federal High Court and state courts: not researched yet

- Corte Suprema de Justicia – Sistema de Información de Jurisprudencia — https://www.csj.gov.py/jurisprudencia/ (caselaw) — unknown (no terms of use published; official court site)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Constitution (BACN id 9580) and laws as enacted from the Congress library (BACN, not consolidated); Supreme Court decisions since 1993 with official headnotes. CSJ search is accent-sensitive.

**Does not reach**

- Consolidated legislation: BACN publishes laws only as enacted; no consolidated source researched yet
- Decrees and other subordinate regulations: only 'Leyes Paraguayas' are searched; not researched yet
- Appeal and first-instance courts: the CSJ database holds Supreme Court decisions only; not researched yet
- Supreme Court decisions before the 1990s: not in the CSJ database (filter covers 1993 on)

- Congreso de la República – Constitución Política del Perú, edición oficial (consolidated) — https://www.congreso.gob.pe/constitucion-del-peru-y-reglamento/ (legislation) — unknown: congreso.gob.pe has no terms-of-use or licence page found (2026-11-10); the Constitution is an official text

- Notes: Case law: Tribunal Constitucional case files, found by case number, party or reporting judge (not full text); slow by design (site asks 30 s between requests). Legislation: El Peruano gazette, full-text search, norms as published (not consolidated), individual norms online from about 2009; the Constitution consolidated (Congress official edition, id 'constitucion').

**Does not reach**

- Poder Judicial case law (ordinary courts, jurisprudencia.pj.gob.pe): WAF blocks our client (403, even robots.txt)
- Consolidated legislation (SPIJ, MINJUS): unreachable from the UK (connect timeout, 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-10)
- Laws before about 2009 and consolidated laws: the Congress's Archivo Digital (leyes.congreso.gob.pe, every law since 1904) serves texts only as PDFs and its robots.txt has 'Disallow: /*.pdf$' (written above the 'User-agent: *' group, so formally ungrouped, but clearly meant for all robots; honoured)
- TC full-text search (jurisprudencia.sedetc.gob.pe): undocumented backend API, not used; search is by number/party
- Older TC resolutions (e.g. 2013): scans only, no text
- Individual norms in El Peruano before about 2009: not published online as single norms

**Sources and terms**

- Portal Orzeczeń Sądów Powszechnych (Ministry of Justice) — https://orzeczenia.ms.gov.pl (caselaw) — not stated on the portal; court judgments are official documents excluded from copyright (art. 4 Polish Copyright Act); re-use of public-sector information under the 2021 Open Data Act
- Sejm ELI API (Chancellery of the Sejm) — https://api.sejm.gov.pl (legislation) — not stated in the API docs; normative acts and official documents are excluded from copyright (art. 4 Polish Copyright Act)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: common courts only (Supreme, Administrative and Constitutional courts are not covered). Laws: title search only; text is the newest consolidated text that has HTML (newer PDF-only ones are named). Cite acts as 'DU/1964/93', provisions as 'art. 415'.

**Does not reach**

- Supreme Court (sn.pl) and Constitutional Tribunal (trybunal.gov.pl): reachable, not researched yet
- Administrative courts (NSA/WSA, orzeczenia.nsa.gov.pl): robots.txt disallows /cbo/find and /cbo/search
- Newest consolidated texts published only as PDF: source exists but not built yet (older HTML consolidation served)
- Full-text legislation search: the Sejm ELI API has title/metadata search only
- Local law (voivodeship official journals): not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- DGSI – Bases Jurídico-Documentais (IGFEJ, Ministério da Justiça) — https://www.dgsi.pt (caselaw) — no published terms; court decisions are excluded from copyright (Código do Direito de Autor, art. 7) — unverified for the database itself
- Tribunal Constitucional – Acórdãos — https://www.tribunalconstitucional.pt/tc/acordaos/ (caselaw) — reproduction authorised for private purposes, citing the source and that the online text is not authentic (page footer); no commercial use
- PGDL – Legislação (Procuradoria-Geral Distrital de Lisboa, Ministério Público); unofficial consolidations — https://www.pgdlisboa.pt/leis/lei_main.php (legislation) — © PGDL, 'Todos os direitos reservados' (footer); statutory texts themselves are excluded from copyright (CDADC art. 7); UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ Unofficial consolidated texts kept by a public prosecutor's office; only the Diário da República is authentic. 'All rights reserved' and no reuse terms: ask PGDL before systematic or commercial reuse.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: DGSI (STJ, STA, Relações, TCAs, Conflitos) with Domino full-text syntax — words, AND/OR, "phrase", [PROCESSO] = "..."; Tribunal Constitucional via its own site (court=tc). Ids: 'jstj/<unid>', 'tc:20260205'; case numbers like 2478/16.1T8GMR.G1.S2 and 'tc:205/2026' also work. Legislation: unofficial PGDL consolidations by nid (Código Civil = 775); provisions as 'Artigo 1022.º', '1022', 'art. 1067-A'.

**Does not reach**

- Diário da República (official, authentic consolidated texts): SPA with no public API; its private endpoints failed for our client
- Official legislation text: PGDL consolidations used here are unofficial; only the Diário da República is authentic
- DGSI decisions: a selection, not every decision; some records are summary-only (no full text published)
- First-instance courts: not researched yet
- Regional law (Azores, Madeira): not researched yet

Full-text search.

**Does not reach**

- Consolidated laws: the portal has Gazette texts as published only; amending laws are separate documents
- Kinyarwanda and French text of laws: only the English column is split into articles; not built yet
- Law reports (portal sections 2.2.x): source exists and works but not built yet (judgments section only)
- Judgment and law PDFs without a text layer: scans only, no text
