**Sources and terms**

- Conseil constitutionnel du Sénégal (decisions and consolidated Constitution) — https://conseilconstitutionnel.sn (caselaw, legislation) — unknown (no terms page; footer has no rights statement)
- Primature / Secrétariat général du Gouvernement (lois, décrets, codes) — https://primature.sn/publications/lois-et-reglements (legislation) — unknown (no terms page; footer '© Primature 2024')
- Ministère de la Justice du Sénégal (codes, lois and décrets as PDF) — https://justice.sec.gouv.sn/publications/textes/ (legislation) — unknown (no terms or legal-notice page; footer '© 2026 Direction de la Dématérialisation et de l'Automatisation')
- JURICAF (AHJUCAF): Cour suprême decisions (unofficial) — https://juricaf.org (caselaw) — ODbL 1.0 (database right held by AHJUCAF; /static/mentionslegales); commercial use allowed; UNOFFICIAL
  - ⚠ Cour suprême decisions come from JURICAF, the unofficial AHJUCAF database (pseudonymised, ODbL licence, attribute JURICAF); its robots.txt forbids paging, so only the first 10 hits of a search are shown.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Conseil constitutionnel (41 decisions, most scanned PDFs without text); Cour suprême only through the unofficial JURICAF database (filter court=supreme, first 10 hits, no paging; get_decision by JURICAF id works). No appeal-court or first-instance (tribunal du travail) decisions. Journal officiel site unreachable (2026-11). Legislation: Constitution (consolidated to 2024-02), ~60 laws, decrees and codes from primature.sn, and ~60 PDF texts from the Ministry of Justice (Code pénal, CPP, COCC, Code de la famille, Code du travail, OHADA acts). Not every law: no Journal officiel online.

**Does not reach**

- Cour suprême: official site coursupreme.gouv.sn is a maintenance page (2026-11-10). JURICAF (unofficial, ODbL) holds ~7,458 decisions to 2025-04, but its robots.txt disallows ?page=, so search shows 10 hits per query and the archive cannot be listed or searched exhaustively
- Appeal courts (cours d'appel) and first-instance courts / tribunaux du travail: no decisions in any source here; Cour suprême decisions that review them can be read, the lower judgment cannot
- Journal officiel: www.jo.gouv.sn connection timeout on http and https (2026-11-05/06 and 2026-11-10); jo.gouv.sn NXDOMAIN
- Statutes not complete: no official full set of laws online; primature.sn and the Ministry of Justice publish a selection (~120 texts), as published, not consolidated
- Most Conseil constitutionnel decisions (2023-2026 files): scans only, no text
- Conseil constitutionnel decisions before 2019 and from 2020-2021: not published online (41 decisions)
- Codes (18 on primature.sn): PDF attachments answered 404 (2026-11-06); the Ministry of Justice PDFs cover the penal, criminal procedure, civil/commercial (COCC), family and labour codes
- Consolidated laws and Constitution changes after 2024-02: not published online; sgg.sn has TLS errors

**Sources and terms**

- Vrhovni sud (Supreme Court of Serbia): Baza sudske prakse — https://www.vrh.sud.rs/sr-lat/baza-sudske-prakse-suda (caselaw) — No licence stated; site footer claims copyright for the Court over all site material. Court decisions are not copyright works under the Serbian Copyright Act (Zakon o autorskom i srodnim pravima, čl. 6).
- Ustavni sud (Constitutional Court): Ustav RS i propisi — https://www.ustavni.sud.rs/ustav-rs-i-propisi/ustav-republike-srbije (legislation) — No licence or terms page; footer '© Република Србија Уставни суд'. Laws are not copyright works under the Serbian Copyright Act (čl. 6).
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: selected, anonymised Supreme Court decisions (Vrhovni sud and its predecessors). Legislation: only the consolidated Constitution, the 2006 Constitutional Law and the Law on the Constitutional Court (Cyrillic, by article); the state legal information system's terms forbid automated access.

**Does not reach**

- Consolidated legislation (pravno-informacioni-sistem.rs): terms forbid automated use without written consent ('Строго је забрањено')
- Laws as adopted (parlament.gov.rs PDFs): not built: current convocation (2024-) only, amending acts as passed, never consolidated
- Appellate and first-instance courts (sudskapraksa.sud.rs): connection timed out (2026-11-06)
- Supreme Court decisions outside the court's selection: not published online
- Constitutional Court: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Judiciary of Seychelles website (judiciary.sc): Decisions from the Courts — https://www.judiciary.sc/resources/court-decisions/ (caselaw) — 'Copyright © 2022 Seychelles Judiciary | All Rights Reserved'; no terms of use page; judgments are public court records
  - ⚠ Judgment PDFs as posted by the Judiciary ('All Rights Reserved'); the text layer of scanned PDFs may contain recognition errors - check the PDF.
- Official Gazette of Seychelles (gazette.sc): Acts, S.I.s and Bills — https://www.gazette.sc (legislation) — '© Copyright 2020-2026 Government of Seychelles'; 'The Gazette is available online, free of charge, to any person' (About the Official Gazette)
- Judiciary of Seychelles website (judiciary.sc): Laws of Seychelles (Constitution and main codes) — https://www.judiciary.sc/seychelles-law/ (legislation) — Constitution: Government Printer 2010 edition, site 'All Rights Reserved'; the codes are Laws.Africa PDFs: 'There is no copyright on the legislative content of this document', PDF copy CC BY 4.0
  - ⚠ Revised texts with an 'as at' date: the Constitution is revised up to August 2018 (later amendment Acts are on gazette.sc); the codes are Laws.Africa consolidations posted by the Judiciary, some with outstanding amendments named in the metadata.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Supreme Court and Constitutional Court decisions listed on judiciary.sc, 2025 on (Court of Appeal list empty). Legislation: the Constitution (revised to 2018) and the Penal, Civil, Criminal Procedure and Civil Procedure Codes as posted on judiciary.sc; Acts, S.I.s and Bills as gazetted, 2020 on, not consolidated.

**Does not reach**

- Court of Appeal decisions: judiciary.sc's Court of Appeal table is empty; not published online
- Judgments before 2025: not listed on judiciary.sc (SeyLII is non-official and its terms prohibit scraping)
- Acts before 2020 other than the Constitution and the four codes on judiciary.sc: not published by an official host (legalaffairs.gov.sc does not resolve); SeyLII has consolidated Acts but its terms say 'Scraping and bulk downloading from this website is strictly prohibited', so it is not used
- Constitution amendments after August 2018: not merged into the judiciary.sc text; the amendment Acts from 2020 are on gazette.sc
- Employment Act, Companies Act and other principal Acts before 2020: not on any official host, so a title search for them finds only later amendments, regulations and Bills
- Gazette items before 2020: not published online (paid request by email only)
- Judgment PDFs with no text layer: scans only, no text

**Sources and terms**

- Sodna praksa (sodnapraksa.si, Supreme Court of Slovenia) — https://www.sodnapraksa.si (caselaw) — unknown: no terms of use published on sodnapraksa.si; court decisions are official texts not protected by copyright (ZASP art. 9). The journal articles also in the database (SOPM/SOSC) are copyrighted and not used; needs none (Keycloak login only for favourites/notes, not used)
- PISRS (Pravni informacijski sistem RS, Government of Slovenia) — https://pisrs.si (legislation) — unknown: the PISRS terms page (/pogoji-uporabe) is an unfilled placeholder (2026-11-05); legislation is not protected by copyright (ZASP art. 9). Texts are unofficial consolidations (NPB); only Uradni list RS is authentic
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: Supreme, higher, labour-appeal and Administrative Court decisions (anonymised, selected; no first-instance or Constitutional Court). Laws: PISRS unofficial consolidated texts, ids like 'ZAKO1263' (OZ), articles as '1. člen'.

**Does not reach**

- Constitutional Court (us-rs.si): blocks our client (403, 2026-11-05)
- First-instance courts: not in sodnapraksa.si (selected higher-court decisions only); not researched yet
- PISRS when it serves its proof-of-work challenge (403): bot check, not solved
- Authentic legislation (Uradni list RS): PISRS consolidations are unofficial; Uradni list not researched yet
- sodnapraksa.si unreachable since 2026-11-10 (connection reset on 80/443, also sodisce.si on the same network): outage or block of UK traffic; case law unavailable while it lasts

**Sources and terms**

- BOE — Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado, Datos abiertos: legislación consolidada — https://www.boe.es/datosabiertos/api/legislacion-consolidada (legislation) — BOE reuse conditions (licencia tipo, Resolución 27-06-2024, under Ley 37/2007): attribution with link to boe.es, consolidated texts must be marked as informative only with their last-update date; commercial use allowed
- Tribunal Constitucional — Buscador de jurisprudencia constitucional (Sistema HJ) — https://hj.tribunalconstitucional.es/ (caselaw) — unknown: hj.tribunalconstitucional.es shows no aviso legal or reuse terms; the main site's aviso legal sits behind a JavaScript browser check and could not be read (2026-11-05). Court decisions are excluded from copyright (Ley de Propiedad Intelectual art. 13).
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Consolidated state and autonomous-community law from the BOE (Spanish only). Law id = BOE identifier (Código Civil BOE-A-1889-4763). Case law covers the Constitutional Court only (id 'STC 31/2010' or its ECLI); ordinary courts (CENDOJ) are behind a CAPTCHA and restrict reuse to personal use.

**Does not reach**

- Ordinary courts incl. Tribunal Supremo and TSJs (CENDOJ): image CAPTCHA; terms restrict reuse to personal use
- Legislation in co-official languages (Catalan, Basque, Galician): not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Rechtspraak Suriname, Hof van Justitie (rechtspraak.sr) — https://rechtspraak.sr/ (caselaw) — no licence, terms or copyright notice on the site (checked 2026-11-06); decisions are published anonymised under the court's Selectie- en anonimiseringsbesluit
- Surinaamse wetten, De Nationale Assemblee (dna.sr) — https://www.dna.sr/wetgeving/surinaamse-wetten/ (legislation) — Auteursrechten page: 'Onder voorwaarde dat (een link naar) de bron wordt vermeld, mogen onderdelen van de inhoud van dna.sr worden overgenomen.' The disclaimer bans commercial use without written permission (checked 2026-11-06); no commercial use
  - ⚠ Cite De Nationale Assemblee (dna.sr) with a link when reusing text; commercial use needs written permission from De Nationale Assemblee. 'Geldende teksten t/m 2005' are older consolidations and may not include later amendments.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Dutch only. Case law: anonymised decisions of the Hof van Justitie, kantongerechten and disciplinary boards from rechtspraak.sr (about 1,400; full-text search, at most 500 hits shown). Legislation: laws published by the National Assembly (dna.sr) as PDFs. Title search only; 'geldende teksten t/m 2005' are pre-2005 consolidations, with later changes listed separately (mostly scanned PDFs that cannot be read here). dna.sr terms allow copying parts with a link to the source; commercial use needs written permission.

**Does not reach**

- Consolidated texts after 2005: 'geldende teksten t/m 2005' are older consolidations; later changes are separate laws
- Amendment laws ('wijzigingen na 2005', e.g. the 2022 Burgerlijk Wetboek amendment, the 2023 Grondwet amendment) and some other laws are scanned PDFs without a text layer: they cannot be read here; open the PDF on dna.sr (the error gives its link). Laws with a poor OCR text layer can lack some articles
- Legislation full-text search: dna.sr is searched by title words only; not built yet
- Case law beyond 500 hits per search: rechtspraak.sr shows at most 500
- Decisions outside the court's selection: not published online (selection and anonymisation decree)
- Official gazette and subordinate regulations: not researched yet

- Riksdagens öppna data, SFS (Källa: Sveriges riksdag) — https://data.riksdagen.se/ (legislation) — Riksdagen open data terms: free to use and redistribute with attribution 'Källa: Sveriges riksdag'; must not suggest the Riksdag stands behind the service; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Case law: higher courts' case reports since 1981 and published judgments since March 2025, newest first (no relevance ranking). Laws: consolidated SFS texts from Riksdagen; cite as '1962:700', provisions as '3 kap. 1 §' or '3:1'.

**Does not reach**

- Case reports before 1981 and judgments not chosen for publication: not in Rättspraxis
- Published judgments (not case reports) before March 2025: not in Rättspraxis
- Earlier versions of laws (point in time): Riksdagen gives the current consolidated text only; not researched yet
- Agency regulations (myndighetsföreskrifter): not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Bundesgericht / Tribunal fédéral — Rechtsprechung (gratis), eurospider search — https://search.bger.ch/ext/eurospider/live/de/php/aza/http/index.php?lang=de (caselaw) — unknown: no reuse terms published; the site footer says '© Alle Rechte vorbehalten', but court decisions are not copyright-protected in Switzerland (Art. 5(1)(c) URG, SR 231.1)
- Fedlex — Systematische Rechtssammlung (Federal Chancellery): SPARQL + filestore — https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/ (legislation) — not copyright-protected (Art. 5 URG); free reuse under Art. 49 PublV (SR 170.512.1): text unchanged, kept apart from comments, with the notice 'Dies ist keine amtliche Veröffentlichung...'; paid redistribution only in value-added form; commercial use allowed
  - ⚠ Fedlex's data host (fedlex.data.admin.ch) disallows automated access to its law files in robots.txt; this tool reads the same files from www.fedlex.admin.ch, which allows it. Get the Federal Chancellery's explicit permission before relying on this at scale.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Federal law (SR, German consolidated text; FR/IT exist on Fedlex) and Federal Supreme Court decisions (since 2000, BGE since 1954, in the language of the case: DE/FR/IT). Law id = SR number (ZGB 210, OR 220). Decision ids: aza://DD-MM-YYYY-4A_640-2011, a case number like 4A_640/2011, or 'BGE 150 III 71'. No cantonal law or cantonal courts.

- Historical versions of federal law: on Fedlex; not built yet (latest consolidation only)
- Unpublished BGer decisions before 2000: not in the free eurospider collection (BGE leading cases from 1954 only)

**Sources and terms**

- Find Case Law, The National Archives (UK): Judicial Committee of the Privy Council judgments — https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (caselaw) — Open Justice Licence v2.0: free re-use incl. commercial; 'computational analysis' (programmatic bulk searching to identify, extract or enrich records) needs a separate, free licence; commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- Statute Law of The Bahamas, Law Reform and Revision Commission (laws.bahamas.gov.bs) — https://laws.bahamas.gov.bs/cms/ (legislation) — Government of The Bahamas Copyright: 'Any reproduction shall ensure its accuracy, and the source and copyright status of the material is made evident to users. The website may only be used for informational non-commercial purposes'; no commercial use
  - ⚠ Statute Law of The Bahamas: Government copyright, informational non-commercial use only; not the authoritative text (that is the printed Revised Edition and the Official Gazette).
- Court of Appeal of The Bahamas judgments (courtofappeal.org.bs) — https://www.courtofappeal.org.bs/judgments.php (caselaw) — © Court of Appeal of the Commonwealth of The Bahamas, all rights reserved; no licence or terms of use; the site's only policy page is a privacy/data policy (read 2026-11-05)
- Supreme Court of The Bahamas judgments, The Judiciary of The Bahamas (courts.bs) — https://courts.bs/judgments/ (caselaw) — © The Judiciary of The Bahamas; no licence or terms of use; the site's only policy page is a privacy/data policy (read 2026-11-05)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Privy Council (final court) judgments in Bahamian appeals, Nov 2009 on, full-text search, from Find Case Law (UK National Archives); Court of Appeal (2003-) and Supreme Court (mostly 2019-) judgments from the courts' own sites (Court of Appeal: case name and catchwords; Supreme Court: title only). Current Acts and subsidiary legislation from the Statute Law of The Bahamas (Revised Edition PDFs, title search only); post-2016 amendments are separate items listed under each Act.

**Does not reach**

- Privy Council judgments before Nov 2009: only on BAILII (no API, forbids scraping); Find Case Law's UKPC collection starts 2009
- Privy Council country filter is heuristic (Find Case Law has no country field): title '(Bahamas)' or header 'From the Court of Appeal of the Commonwealth of The Bahamas'; a judgment with neither (header worded otherwise, untitled country) is missed
- Full-text search: Bahamian court lists match case names (Court of Appeal also catchwords) only; the laws site search (/cms/search/search.php) is robots-disallowed
- Supreme Court judgments before ~2019: not published online on courts.bs
- Consolidated text with post-2016 amendments merged in: not published (amendments are separate items)
- Magistrates' courts and tribunals: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Judiciary of Trinidad and Tobago: Recent Judgments (ttlawcourts.org) and judgment PDFs (webopac.ttlawcourts.org) — https://www.ttlawcourts.org/media-public-information/recent-judgments (caselaw) — © The Judiciary of Trinidad and Tobago; Copyright Act Chap. 22:19. Terms: material 'may be downloaded for information purposes'; no commercial use
  - ⚠ Personal use only: Judiciary terms say the site is maintained for personal use and viewing; its material may be downloaded for information purposes.
- Digital Legislative Library, Law Revision Commission (laws.gov.tt) — https://laws.gov.tt/ttdll-web/revision/list (legislation) — © Ministry of Land and Legal Affairs, all rights reserved; no licence or reuse terms stated
  - ⚠ Unofficial versions: the Law Revision Commission says only the printed Revised Laws are official; revised editions run to 31 Dec 2016, later updates are unofficial.
- Find Case Law, The National Archives — https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (caselaw) — Open Justice Licence v2.0: free re-use incl. commercial; 'computational analysis' (programmatic bulk searching to identify, extract or enrich records) needs a separate, free licence; commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Court of Appeal and High Court judgments published by the Judiciary (search by case name, suit number or delivery date; text from the official PDF). Privy Council (final court) appeals from T&T 2009 on via Find Case Law: filter court='privy council'. Revised Acts by chapter from the Law Revision Commission, its later unofficial updates, and every Act as passed by year (filter year); title search only.

**Does not reach**

- Official text of Acts: only the printed Revised Laws are official; editions run to 31 Dec 2016, later updates unofficial; Acts since 2017 are given as passed, not consolidated
- Full-text search of Acts: the Digital Legislative Library searches titles only
- Privy Council judgments before 2009: only on BAILII, which forbids scraping; T&T appeals are picked out of Find Case Law by title, so a title naming no jurisdiction may slip through
- Rulings with no judgment file attached: not published online (node page only)
- Magistrates' Courts and tribunals: not researched yet
- Subsidiary legislation and the Gazette: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- Bedesten (Adalet Bakanlığı, mevzuat.adalet.gov.tr backend) — https://mevzuat.adalet.gov.tr (caselaw, legislation) — No published terms (undocumented public-site API). Court decisions and legislation are excluded from copyright, FSEK (Law 5846) art. 31 (unverified on an official terms page)
- Anayasa Mahkemesi Kararlar Bilgi Bankası — https://kararlarbilgibankasi.anayasa.gov.tr (caselaw) — No published terms. Decisions are excluded from copyright, FSEK art. 31 (unverified on an official terms page)
- Uyuşmazlık Mahkemesi Karar Arama — https://kararlar.uyusmazlik.gov.tr (caselaw) — No published terms; no robots.txt (404, 2026-11-10). Decisions are excluded from copyright, FSEK art. 31 (unverified on an official terms page)
- Sayıştay Kararlar (Genel Kurul, Temyiz Kurulu, Daire) — https://www.sayistay.gov.tr/KararlarDaire (caselaw) — No terms page found (only an information-security policy); robots.txt has no Disallow (2026-11-10). FSEK art. 31 (unverified on an official terms page)
- Rekabet Kurumu Kurul Kararı Arama — https://www.rekabet.gov.tr/tr/Kararlar (caselaw) — No terms page found; no robots.txt (error page, 2026-11-10). Board decisions are official texts, FSEK art. 31 (unverified on an official terms page)
- Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı Özelgeler — https://gib.gov.tr/mevzuat/ozelgeler (caselaw) — No terms page found; robots.txt 'User-agent: * Allow: /' (2026-11-10). Advance tax rulings, not court decisions
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Yargıtay, Danıştay, BAM civil chambers, first-instance civil and AYM decisions (AYM norm review is read from normkararlarbilgibankasi.anayasa.gov.tr, same terms as the individual-application bank), plus Uyuşmazlık Mahkemesi, Sayıştay, Rekabet Kurulu and GİB özelge banks (court=...); consolidated legislation with per-article text. Quote multi-word phrases: unquoted words are OR-ed. Bedesten is slow on purpose (3.5 s between requests); an Uyuşmazlık text search takes ~20 s server-side and sometimes over 60 s (2026-11-10). Newest Yargıtay data lags ~5 weeks (2026-11-07).

**Does not reach**

- Yargıtay decisions from the last ~5 weeks: not yet in Bedesten (source lag, 2026-11-07)
- KİK (public procurement board) decisions: ekapv2.kik.gov.tr API requires AES-signed request headers (anti-automation); not built
- BTK board decisions: the only search is www.btk.tr/api/, which robots.txt disallows for all user agents
- BDDK board decisions, Sigorta Tahkim Komisyonu awards: no official search endpoint (yargi-mcp uses a third-party web-search API); not built
- Yargıtay Karar Arama (karararama.yargitay.gov.tr), which could fill the Bedesten lag: connection times out from a UK IP (2026-11-10)
- Resmî Gazete (as-published texts, daily index): source exists (HTML only) but not built yet
- KVKK decisions: kvkk.gov.tr has no search endpoint (yargi-mcp uses a third-party web-search API); mostly decision summaries; not built
- SPK, EPDK, RTÜK, BDDK and Ombudsman decisions: not researched yet
- Professional-body rules never published in the Resmî Gazete, e.g. the TBB Meslek Kuralları (Türkiye Barolar Birliği): not in Bedesten (no title match, 2026-11-11); the TBB publishes them itself
- Regional administrative courts (Bölge İdare Mahkemeleri): not researched yet (Bedesten item types unverified)
- Regional appeal criminal chambers (BAM ceza daireleri) and first-instance criminal courts: no Bedesten item type queried (only ISTINAFHUKUK and YERELHUKUK, civil)

**Sources and terms**

- United Nations Treaty Collection (treaties.un.org), MTDSG status records and certified true copies — https://treaties.un.org/Pages/ParticipationStatus.aspx?clang=_en (legislation) — © United Nations; UN website Terms of Use: download and copy for personal, non-commercial use, no resale, redistribution or derivative compilations; no commercial use
  - ⚠ UN Terms of Use: materials may be downloaded and copied for personal, non-commercial use only, without redistribution or derivative compilations.
- Tools: search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Multilateral treaties deposited with the UN Secretary-General (MTDSG), by MTDSG number (IV-4 = ICCPR, XXI-6 = UNCLOS). Status, parties, reservations and objections as provisions; treaty text from the certified true copy PDF where it has a text layer. First unfiltered search takes ~70 s (Crawl-delay 2).

**Does not reach**

- Treaty text when the certified copy has no usable text layer or is too large: scans only, no text (status record instead)
- Treaties registered but not deposited with the Secretary-General (UNTS, incl. bilateral): not researched yet
- Full-text search across treaty texts: the site's search is a multi-step ASP.NET form; not built yet
- Articles in French and the other official languages: only English headings are cut out; not built yet

**Sources and terms**

- Find Case Law, The National Archives — https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (caselaw) — Open Justice Licence v2.0: free re-use incl. commercial; 'computational analysis' (programmatic bulk searching to identify, extract or enrich records) needs a separate, free licence; commercial use allowed; AI use opted out
- legislation.gov.uk, The National Archives — https://www.legislation.gov.uk (legislation) — Open Government Licence v3.0; commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation: England & Wales, Scotland, NI and UK-wide. Case law: England & Wales and UK-wide courts only (Scottish and NI cases only via UKSC/UKPC), 2003 onward (older: BAILII, no API). search_caselaw requires ALL words to match; neutral citations are not searchable, pass them to get_decision directly. Law ids are type/year/number, e.g. ukpga/2006/46 (Companies Act 2006).

**Does not reach**

- Case law before 2003 and many first-instance decisions: only on BAILII, which forbids scraping
- Hosted or bulk use of Find Case Law: needs the free computational-analysis licence (not yet obtained)
- Original-print PDFs of legislation: robots.txt disallows PDF/DOCX
- Scottish and Northern Irish court judgments outside Find Case Law: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- govinfo (U.S. Government Publishing Office): USCOURTS opinions and U.S. Reports — https://www.govinfo.gov (caselaw, legislation) — Public domain (US Government works, 17 U.S.C. 105; court opinions); commercial use allowed; needs free key for search (api.data.gov, env WLM_US_GOVINFO_KEY; falls back to DEMO_KEY, ~10 searches/day); metadata and PDFs need none
- Supreme Court of the United States: opinions of the Court (supremecourt.gov) — https://www.supremecourt.gov (caselaw) — Public domain (court opinions; US Government works, 17 U.S.C. 105); commercial use allowed
- National Archives: Constitution of the United States (transcription) — https://www.archives.gov (legislation) — Public domain / CC0 1.0 (NARA Copyright, Restrictions, and Permissions Notice on /global-pages/privacy.html); commercial use allowed
- govinfo (U.S. Government Publishing Office): Statutes at Large and Public and Private Laws — https://www.govinfo.gov (legislation) — Public domain (US Government works, 17 U.S.C. 105; govinfo Public Domain & Copyright Notice); commercial use allowed; needs none for citations ('1 Stat. 50', 'Pub. L. 117-58': link service, MODS, PDF/HTML); full-text search uses the govinfo API key like the other collections
- United States Code (Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House) — https://uscode.house.gov (legislation) — Public domain (US Government work, 17 U.S.C. 105); commercial use allowed
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Federal only. Case law: govinfo (lower federal courts ~2004 on + bound U.S. Reports to vol. 586) and supremecourt.gov (Supreme Court opinions from October Term 2018 on: collection SUPREMECOURT; ids '606 U.S. 942' or a docket), PDF text. Legislation: US Code by title and section, e.g. '42 USC 1983', and the Constitution ('US Constitution'; provisions 'preamble', 'art. I', 'art. I sec. 8', 'amend. XIV') from the National Archives transcription. Acts as enacted: Statutes at Large vols 1-138 (1789-2024; ids '1 Stat. 50', 'STATUTE-1-Pg50', 'Pub. L. 85-1'; provisions are Stat. pages) and public/private laws from 1995 ('Pub. L. 119-1'; provisions are sections); full-text search with filter collection STATUTE or PLAW. No state law, no CFR.

**Does not reach**

- Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR): robots.txt disallows the full-text endpoint /api/versioner/v1/full/
- Supreme Court from October Term 2018 on: searchable by name, docket, citation and the Court's one-line summary only (no full-text search); 'opinions relating to orders' not wired
- Lower federal court opinions before ~2004: not in govinfo USCOURTS
- State statutes and state case law: not built yet (federal only)
- Federal Register and Congress bills: source exists and works but not built yet
- US Constitution: National Archives transcription of the parchment text (original spelling; superseded clauses are not marked in the articles, only in amendment notes)
- Statutes at Large: page PDFs with GPO's text layer; older volumes are scans, so expect OCR errors, and a granule's first and last pages can carry the neighbouring acts. Laws newer than vol. 138 (2024) come from PLAW (1995 on) until bound
- Public laws: as enacted, not consolidated (the consolidated text of codified provisions is the US Code); new laws reach govinfo PLAW some weeks after enactment
- Case-law search beyond ~10/day: needs a free api.data.gov key (WLM_US_GOVINFO_KEY), else DEMO_KEY

**Sources and terms**

- IMPO – Banco de Datos de normativa (Dirección Nacional de Impresiones y Publicaciones Oficiales) — https://www.impo.com.uy/datos-abiertos/ (legislation) — Licencia de Datos Abiertos – Uruguay v0.1 for the ?json=true open data (IMPO Datos Abiertos page, since July 2018: commercial and non-commercial use, attribution to IMPO + licence + dataset required); but IMPO's 'Condiciones de Uso del Banco de Datos' still say use is personal and forbid copying, passing to third parties and commercialisation
  - ⚠ IMPO licenses its JSON as open data (Licencia de Datos Abiertos – Uruguay, attribution required), but its Banco de Datos terms forbid copying, redistribution and commercial use; get IMPO's explicit confirmation before redistributing or using texts commercially.
- Base de Jurisprudencia Nacional Pública (BJN), Poder Judicial — https://bjn.poderjudicial.gub.uy/BJNPUBLICA/busquedaSelectiva.seam (caselaw) — unknown; no terms or licence page found for BJN (free access without login per its user manual)
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Legislation: IMPO consolidated texts (laws, decrees, codes, Constitution); IMPO's search is robots-disallowed, so look up by code name or 'ley N de YYYY'. Case law: BJN (all courts), ids are 'número | sede | fecha'.

**Does not reach**

- Legislation keyword search: IMPO's search under /cgi-bin/ is disallowed by robots.txt (code name or law number only)
- IMPO subscription-only content: answers 'Acceso no válido' (paid; which texts, unverified)
- Newest court decisions: the BJN index lags ~2 months
- Parliament (parlamento.gub.uy): CloudFront 403 to our client
- Departmental (regional) decrees: not researched yet

**Sources and terms**

- lex.uz, National Database of Legislation (Ministry of Justice, 'Adolat' National Legal Information Centre) — https://lex.uz (legislation, caselaw) — lex.uz terms (/ru/axborot): personal use only; copying or distribution for profit needs the Centre's written permission; no commercial use
  - ⚠ Personal use only: lex.uz terms allow use of its information for personal purposes only; copying, distribution or transfer for profit needs the Adolat Centre's written permission.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision, search_legislation, get_legislation_toc, get_legislation_provision, get_legislation_text
- Notes: Official Ministry of Justice database: current consolidated texts (Uzbek, Russian, some English) and selected court decisions. Each language version has its own id. Case-law branch filter: civil, economic or criminal (no administrative). Personal use only under the site terms.

**Does not reach**

- Use beyond personal purposes: lex.uz terms allow use 'only for personal purposes'; needs the Adolat Centre's permission
- Court decisions outside lex.uz's selection (most lower-court judgments): not published on lex.uz
- English texts: only some acts have an English version on lex.uz
- Full Supreme Court archive on public.sud.uz (the courts' publication portal): every decision file needs a captcha token (checked 2026-11-10); not used
- Administrative-court decisions by branch: the branch filter covers civil, economic and criminal only; administrative cases come only in unfiltered searches

- Published court judgments (congbobanan.toaan.gov.vn): connection reset / timed out from the UK (2026-11-06)
- Codification (phapdien.moj.gov.vn): timed out from the UK
- vanban.chinhphu.vn scanned PDFs (e.g. its copy of the 2015 Civil Code; vbpl.vn has the text) and the 2026 precedents 83-90: scans only, no text

**Sources and terms**

- WTO dispute pages and dispute data files (www.wto.org) — https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/dispu_e/dispu_status_e.htm (caselaw) — © World Trade Organization. Unrestricted official documents and legal texts are free for public use; other material may be reproduced for non-commercial purposes with attribution, and the WTO must be informed. Commercial use needs written permission.; no commercial use
  - ⚠ WTO case summaries are Secretariat material: reuse is non-commercial with attribution to the WTO, and the summaries are not official or exhaustive.
- Tools: search_caselaw, get_decision
- Notes: WTO disputes DS1 onwards. Search covers number, title, short title, parties, subject and agreements cited. get_decision('DS600') gives the Secretariat's summary of the dispute (incl. key panel/AB findings); report texts on docs.wto.org are not fetched (robots). The agreement texts themselves (GATT 1994, Anti-Dumping Agreement, SCM, TRIPS ...) are not covered: read them at https://www.wto.org/english/docs_e/legal_e/legal_e.htm.

**Does not reach**

- WTO agreement texts (GATT 1994, Anti-Dumping Agreement etc.): no legislation search; official texts at https://www.wto.org/english/docs_e/legal_e/legal_e.htm
- Panel and Appellate Body report texts (docs.wto.org): robots.txt disallows ('Disallow: /')
- Submissions, arbitration awards and other WT/DS documents: on docs.wto.org, robots.txt disallows
- French and Spanish versions of the dispute pages: not built yet (English only)
- GATT-era disputes before 1995: not researched yet
